waX bshākakhu/ shāgi/rdzi / ra mishrī ( 11) zhu/krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/gli (she/rmyu krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang / cizhime dzizhu 744/yi spro 'a༄༄ 6

'dul ba/ (spyilji (11)0006 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/ 3ba lang skyong sogs bshad pa/(smad) 3drag shul can sogs bshad pa/ 6 bran can sogs bshad pa/ 91btsa' zhugs pa sogs bshad pa/ 240'phyan pa sogs bshad pa/ 294mdun du 'gro bar mi bya ba sogs bshad pa/ 229tshong dpon gyis kyang zas lhag ma zhes sogs bshad pa/ da ldadage slong lhag ma mi rung ste zhes sogs bshad pa/ 339btsog pa'i gnas su mi dor ba sogs bshad pa/ 44phra mo'i sgo bdun pa/ 'aspyod pa'i n+de tshan/ lhuthe tshom sogs bshad pa/ da48sang kāg k+ṣi sogs bshad pa/ 2671

mtshan gnyis sogs bshad pa/ 369mtshan ma tsam sogs bshad pa/ 372dge slong pas las brjod pa sogs bshad pa/ 376chang 'tshong ma sogs bshad pa/ 78dge slong ma las dge slong nang du bzhag pa sogs bshad pa/ 388phyi rol dge slong bzod mi gsol zhes sogs bshad pa/ 412lus la pha gus phyi bar mi bya ba sogs bshad pa/ 417phra mo'i sgo brgyad ba/ dbyung ba'i n+de tshan/ 417dge slong ma yi bkur sti bri ba sogs bshad pa/ 417dge slong mas bzod pa gsol pa sogs bshad pa/ 423sgo yi drung na 'khod pa sogs bshad pa/ 429mi 'bros par bsgo ba sogs bshad pa/ 431khar ba'i snod sogs bshad pa/ 440bud med chu 'gram phye mas min zhes sogs bshad pa/ 450bud med gar dang brel ba dang zhes sogs bshad pa/ 454brtags nas 'gro bar bya ba sogs bshad pa/ 464snam sbyar ci rigs bgo ba sogs bshad pa/ 474mal na sbrul nag nyal ba sogs bshad pa/ 539ngag ldan gyis zhus pa sogs bshad pa/ 546ston pa dang 'dul ba sogs bshad pa/ 567tsa pa la sogs bshad pa/ 623rgya gar gyi mkhan po bca ka ra pra bha dang /dha shrī pra bha dang /lots+tsha ba bad de dpal ci 'byor gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(806) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(979)2

༄༅༅/ /'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/ bam po nyi shu ②brgyad pa/khyod kyi ③'dod pa gnas bzang por skyes te/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba dang phrad par bdag gis bya'o/ /des de rgyal po shar ba dang lhan cig phrad par byas te/ nor lhas byin de dang lhan cig shin tu chags par gyur pa dang / gser phreng can gyis sbyor ba 'chang la lha ④ni gson te/ rgyal po gtum po rab snang gi sras mo nor lhas byin la glang po che'i cho ga slob bo zhes spring ngo / /des kyang rgyan lnga mi mngon par byas nas bdag nyid gos hrul po bgos te ming dpyid ldan zhes bya bar btags nas smyon pa'i cha lugs kyis 'phags rgyal du song ngo / /de der lam po che dang / srang dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dag tu rgyug mchong rgal zhing dpyid ldan dga'o 0zhes smyon tshig kyang smra'o/ /gang dag gis 'di dusbyor ba 'chang ba ⑦yin no zhes de ngo shes pa de 11—3

dag la ni des ①rgyan byin pa dang / de dag gis de blangs nas cang mi zer bar 'gro'o/ /gang dag mi shes pa de dag ni 'di smyon pa zhig go zhes yal bar gtong ste/ de rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang khyim bzang po gang du zhugs pa der bza' ba dang / me tog dang gos dag kyang rnyed cing shar ba dang lhan cig gsang ste gros gcig go/ /ji ⑤tsam dus gzhan zhig na nor lhas byin gyis rgyal po shar ba'i bu la smras pa/ lha gal te na bdag gi pas tshor du mchis tshur spyon 'bros so/ /des smras pa/ lha mo gal te de lta na song la pha la 'di skad ces yab bdag gis glang po che'i cho ga ni lobs na 'on kyang las su bgyi ba ma mthong ste / de'i slad du lhas bdag la glang po che mo bzang ldan ci bder bgyid du stsol cig dang de la 'tshal nas las dag blta bar bgyi'o zhes gyis shig /de song nas rgyal po la de bzhin smras pa dang / rgyal po gtum po rab snang gis kyang glang po che'i rdzi rnams la shes ldan dag glang po che mo bzang ldan bu mo nor lhas byin la ci bder gyis la/ de la zhon nas las dag bltar ②chug shig ④ces bsgo'o//de dag gis de la glang po che mo bzang ldan ci bder byas pa dang / de rgyal po shar ba'i bu dang lhan ⑤cig de la zhon nas 'bros pa'i thabs shom par rtsom ste/res 'ga' ni snga dro song zhing nyi ma phyed na slar du'ong / res 'ga' ni nyi ma phyed na song zhing phyi dro slar 'ong / res 'ga' ni phyi dro song nas dgongs ④su slar 'ong / res 'ga' ni dgongs ⑧song nas mtshan mo nam phyed na slar 'ong /res 'ga' ni 'jing la slar 'ong / res 'ga' ni lnga tshigs ⑨la slar 'ong / res 'ga' ni nam chung na slar 'ong ⑩/ res 'ga' ni skya rengs ⑩shar na slar 'ong ngo / /shar bas sbyor ba 'chang la tshu'abros pa'i thabs smras pa dang / des glang 11—4

po che'i lci ba dag phyir dbyung bar brtsams so/ /chab sgo ba dag gis smras pa/dpyid ldan 'di ci yin/ des smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po'i bshos su byas te 'di dag der la dur ①'gyur ro zhes byas pa dang / de dag gis bgad nas 'di ni smyon pa'o snyam nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /des kyang de dag khyer te kau shāsbyi'i ②lam gyi bar bar du shing gi yal ga la dpyangs ①so/ /yang glang po che'i gcin dag gis bum pa bkang ste bkur bar brtsams pa dang / sgo ba dag gis de bzhin du dris pa dang / des smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po'i dubashos su byas te 'di ni der skyems su 'gyur ro zhes byas pa dang / de dag de bzhin du 'di ni smyon pa yin no snyam nas bgad ⑤de 'khod do/ /des kyang de khyer te kau'u shāsbyi'i phyolam gyi bar bar du shing gi yal ga la dpyangs ⑦so/ /rgyal po shar ba dang / sbyor ba 'chang dang / gser phreng can gyis nyi ma che ge ⑤mo zhig la phyogs che ge mo zhig tu thams cad 'du bar bya'o zhes dus btab nas rgyal po shar ba'i bu dang / nor lhas byin glang po che mo bzang ldan la zhon nas phyogs der song ste/ sbyor ba 'chang dang / gser phreng can yang de nyid la zhon te/de rnams pi bang ⑨snyan pa len zhing dong ba na/ rgyal po shar ba'i bus pi bang ⑩snyan pa blangs pa dang / sbyor ba 'chang dga' ba skyes te glu blangs pa/ bzang ldan ma dang dbyangs 7snyan dang / /nor lhas byin dang shar ba dang / /gser phreng can dang dpyid ldan dang / /'di dag don mthun 'dong ba tsoyin/ /dus gang du de dag slar 'ong ba'i dus de yang myur du thal/ dus tha ma gang yin pa de yang thal nas rgyal po gtum po rab snang gis gsos pa la smras pa/ gsos pa nor lhas byin deng tsothogs na 'di ci las gyur ces byas pa dang / gsos 11—5

pas btsal bar brtsams ①pa las ma rnyed nas/ des rgyal po la smras pa/ rgyal po shar ba'i bus glang po che mo bzang ldan la 'tshal te/ nor lhas byin khrid nas bros lags so/ /rgyal po sngangs ②nas smras pa/ gsos pa myur du song la glang po che 'dam ④bu'i ri la zhon te shar ba dang / nor lhas byin khrid de shog shig/de rings pa rings par glang po che 'dam bu'i ri la zhon nas bsnyags so/ /des bsnyags ④te slebs la thug nas sbyor ba 'chang gis glang po che'i lci ba'i thum po bshig pa dang / 'dam bu'i ris de bsnam ⑤par brtsams so/ /ji srid snom pa de'i bar du glang po che mo bzang ldan gyis dpag tshad bcu 'das so/ /yang 'dam bu'i ris slebs ⑥la thug nas sbyor ba 'chang gis gcin gyi bum pa gcig ⑦pa dang 'dam bu'i ris de bsnams ⑤par brtsams so/ /ji srid snom pa de'i bar du glang po che mo bzang ldan gyis dpag med gzhan bcu 'das te/gzhan gyi yul du phyin par gyur pa dang / lko gsos pas bsams pa 'di ni gzhan gyi yul yin pas glang po che 'dam bu'i ri yang shor du 'ong gis 0ldog go snyam nas de re tshuthag chad de slar log go/ /rgyal po gtum po rab snang gis smras pa/ gsos pa ci grag /des smras pa/ lha ci zhig gda' bros lags mod ces byas pa dang / rgyal po lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas sems khong du 7chud cing 'dug go/ /rgyal po shar ba'i bu yang srog stor ba las slar rnyed de/ kau shāsbyir 8'ongs nas dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / bkren 0pa dang / phongs pa dang / mdza' bo dang / phu nu dang / gnyen rnams la sbyin pa dag byin zhing dga' ston chen po byas nas nor lhas byin dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur 8spyod par byed do/ /dus gzhan zhig na khang 11—6

bzangs kyi ①thog tu byung nas nor lhas byin dang lhan cig tu bre mo gtam dag zer zhing 'khod pa las smras pa/ lha mo khyod kyang ngas de ltar sgyus laphrogs pa yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha khyod kyang de bzhin du bdag gi phas thabs kyis bzung ste bzhag pa lags so/ /des smras pa/ lha mo ci ①ste khyod ④kyi pha 'dir bkug ste tha ga ⑤pa'i las slob tu ma bcug na/ nga rgyal po shar ba'i bu ma yin du zad ces byas pa dang / de khros bzhin du cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /rgyal po shar bas sbyor ba 'chang la smras pa/ nga'i mi dga' ba khyod kyis bsal ⑥bar nus sam / lha ci zhig bgyi/ rgyal po gtum po rab snang mgul pa nas thogs te 'dir khug la tha ga ⑦pa'i las slob tu chug shigashe /des smras pa/ lha gang gi tshe khyod kyis nor lhas byin dang glang po che mo bzang ldan phyogs pa'i tshe don gyis ⑨na khyod kyi mi dgyes pa bsal tshulags mod kyi/ 'on kyang gal te rngo thog kyang gdas bsams 0te bgyi'o zhes byas te/ des 'phags rgyal du 'gro ba'i zong chadag sta ⑫gon byas nas ded dpon spro ba bskyed de/ smad 'tshong ④ma gzugs dang na tshod dang ldan pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhig kyang ded tsodapon gyi chung mar byas nas de rim gyis grong dang / grong khyer dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang rnams su tshong dus dag lta zhing 'phags rgyal du phyin to/ /rgyal po gtum po rab snang gis nor mang po dang ldan pa'i ded dpon zhig 'ongs so zhes thos so/ /des thos nas kyang bdag nyid nor rtsir song ste des 'gron po ⑩de dag la dris pa/ shes ldan dag ded dpon gyi khyim gang yin/ de dag gis ded dpon gyi khyim ni 'di yin no zhes byas pa dang / rgyal po der song ste sgor 'dug nas ded dpon gang na 'dug ces dris pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/11—7

sgor byung ste song ngo / /des smras pa/ 'di na su 'dug de rnams kyis smras pa/ded dpon gyi ༅chung ma mchis so/ /des sgo gtan phye ste nang du zhugs pa dang ji tsam na ded dpon gyi chung ma gzugs dang na tshod bzang bas 'phags rgyal na gnas pa'i bud med thams cad zil gyis gnon pa zhig mthong ngo / /des de mthong nas kyang rab tu chags par gyur te smras pa/ bzang mo nga dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad thun ded dpon gyi sho gam gtang zungo / /des smras pa/gal te de lta na mal 'dir 'dug shig ④ces byas pa dang / 'dod chags kyis log par ④gyur pas ni mi bya ba ci yang med pa'i phyir de der 'dug pa dang /rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis sgo bcad de 9khyogs su bcug nas mi bzhis bteg ste dze+eglu len cing sgo gcig dunas 'phags rgyal du shezhugs so/ /de na kha cig ni thal mo rdob/ kha cig ni rgod/ma kha cig ni 'di skad du glu len te/ sbrang ma dag gis zla ba zos/ /rnam thos bu ni gnyer pas ded/ /sa gzhi nags bcas mkha' la 'phags/ /smad 'tshong mas ni rab snang khrid/ /ces byas pa dang /'phags rgyal na gnas pa rnams kyis bsams pa/ ci'i phyir tshong pa 'di dag de skad ces zer snyam pa las/ de rnams sgo gzhan rgyu du byung ste/ smyags bcad de nyu)bros te song ngo / /gsos pa yang phan tshun du rgyal po tshol zhing /dī de rim gyis kau shāsbyir 6song ngo / /blon po dag gis rgyal po shar ba la smras pa/ lha dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ rgyal po byarab snang ni 'dir khugs lags so zhes byas pa dang / rgyal po shar bas smras pa/ shes ldan dag deng la de thogs te tha ga tshupa'i las slob tu chug shig ⑩ /rgyal po rab snang 'dir 'ongs par nor lhas byin la su yang ma zer cig par khrims su yang chos shig ces bsgo'o/ /ji 11—8

tsam dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po shar ba'i bu nor lhas byin dang lhan cig tu khang bzangs kyi ༅steng du byung ste 'dug pa na rgyal po gtum po rab snang thags kyi gra khang khunas bya ba zhig gi phyir sgor byung ba dang rgyal po shar bas de mthong nas/des nor lhas byin la smras pa/ mi 'o ni su yin khyod kyis shes sam/ des kyang ring zhig du brtags pa dang / rgyal po de spyi gcer du yin pas ngo shes nas de mchi mas brnangs bzhin du 'dug ste des bsams pa/ rgyal po ngan pa 'dis nga'i pha 'di 'dra ba'i gnas skabs su byas kyis cogal te rgyal po ngan pa 'di ma bsad na nor lhas byin ma yin du zad/ ji ltar bsad pa yang bdag nyid kyis mi tshor ba de ltar gsad 3do snyam mo/ /rgyal po de yang yid rno ba zhig pas de khros par shes nas des sbyor ba 'chang la bsgo ba/ sbyor ba 'chang dgra la sha lon zin gyis ༅song la rgyal po gtum po rab snang khrol te khrus gyis zan byin la bkur sti tsochen pos 'phags rgyal du skyol cig ces bsgo ba dang / des kyang ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin du 'phags rgyal du bskyal to/ /nor lhas byin gyis bsams pa/ gal te bdag gis 'di nga nyid gsad pa'i thabs brtsams na g.yon can 'dis 'phrigs par 'ong bas 3dus chung zhig gis thobar du brid do snyam nas/ des de la re zhig cung chozad cig bgad nyunyepa dang / dga' ba dang / rtse ba dang / dga' mgur spyad pa dag gis brid do/ /de nas de gos dri ma can gyon te khri'u dra ba can la nyal zhing 'dug pa dang / rgyal po shar ba'i bus smras pa/ lha mo 'di ci'i mtha tshig /des smras pa/ lha lha rnams 'khrugs lags so/ /des smras pa/ lha mo mi bdog gam/ ci ji ltar dam bcas pa gzhan 8gyis shig /des smras pa/ lha gang bdag gis dam bcas pa 11—9

de mi 'grub lags mod/ rgyal pos smras pa/ khyod kyis ①dam ci bcas/gang gis na khyod mi dga' bar gyur pa smros shig dang thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas / khyod mi dga' bar ma byed cig /des smras pa/ gang gi zutshe bdag gi phas lha bzung ste bzhag pa de'i tshe bdag gis lha la 'di skad du ci ste lha dang bdag ④lhan cig bde legs su kau shāsbyir phyephyin nabyu / der lha dang bdag lhan cig nyin zhag bdun gyi bar du zas mi bza' rtsozhing zhag bdun 'das nasam/ lha ni 3me tog gi phreng bas rkang pa'i rtse mo nas spyi bo'i bar du dkris te ra ba'i khar 'dug par bya'o/ /bdag ni dka' mthub rdzogs nas bram ze stong la zan byin la mchod pa dang bkur snyi nyunyecher bya'o zhes dam bcas na da lta skubatsun mo'i 'khor rgya che bar gyur pas ci'i slad du 'di lta bu mdzardo par 'gyur snyam du bdag de sems shing mchis te/ mdor na gum ju lags su bas so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ lha mo khyod kyis lha la mugasol ba btab pa yang don gyis na nga'i ched kho na yin pas longs shig dang thams cad bsgrub par bya'o zhes byas pa dang / de langs te des khyi gu gnyis shig ra ba'i drung du btags 0te bzhag nasari 6 / de ji tsam mi tsam gyi sha za nus pa de tsam du sha gong nas gong du bskyed de byin no/ /gang gi tshe khyi gu de gnyis sha de tsam za nus pa de'i tshe rgyal po dang lhan cig nyin zhag bdun gyi bar du 'dug cing de ni mtshan mo za/ rgyal po shar ba ni chung ma de la chags pas nyin zhag bdun 8gyi bar du ma zos pas de lus skya bo bseng skyebaseng por gyur cing sha bri ngan pa dang / nyam chung ba dang /rmya chabar gyur to/ /zhag bdun lon ⑩pa dang / nor lhas byin gyis me tog phreng rgyud mkhan rnams la yang rgyus pa dag gis me tog dri zhim po dag rgyus tshul 11—10

myur du khyer te ༅shog shig ②ces bsgo'o/ /sbyor ba 'chang la yang deng du lha'i dka' thub rdzogs kyis rgukhyod kyis grong khyer mdzes par gyis la bram ze stong dang /rgyal po btsun mo'i 'khor codang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / grong khyer gyi skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i zan sbyor cig ces bsgo'o/ /blon po gzhan dag ni mi tshor bar pa bya ba'i phyir gnas phyogazhan dang gzhan dag tu las su bskos so/ /sbyor ba 'chang yang rgyal po la snying nye zhing rjes su chags pas grong khyer de rdo dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo ni med par byas/ tsan dan gyi chus ni chag chag btab/ bdug pa dri zhim po'i pog phor ni bzhag /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag sheni bsgreng ⑧/ mu tig dang / dar gyi chun po dang / lda ldi ni dpyangasasgyu / ci me tog rnam pa sna tshogs ni bkram ste lha rnams kyi skyed tsomos tshal dga' ba'i tshal nyunyebazhin du dga' dga' ltar byas nas gnas dang nyunyeganas rnams su rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs ni bsgrags/ gar mkhan dang /snyan dngags skumakhan dang / 'jo tshar can gyi bro mkhan rnams kyis ni bro gar bya bar brtsams so/ /ca co chen po byung ba rtsade'i tshe nor lhas byin gyis rgyal po shar ba'i bu ra ba'i khar rkang pa'i rtse mo nas spyi bo'i bar du me tog gis dkris nas bsnyal lo/ /de nas ra ba'i kha nas phul nas lhung skyem thag tu gson por khyi dag gis rus byagong 'ba' zhig byalus par byas te/ bya rog dang / bya rgod dang / wa 8dang / mi ro la za ba'i srog chags gzhan dag kyang 'thab par gyur to/ / ko shāsbyir 2lha ra ba'i kha nas grong khyer mdzes pa lta ba las lhung ste / khyi dag gis zos so zhes ku co'i sgra cher gyur pa dang / de na du kha cig ni ngu / kha cig ni dga'/ kha cig ni tha mal par 'dug /kha cig ni 11—11

'phrog rlom ①byed par gyur to/ /ku co chen po byung ba de'i tshe kau shāsbyi zhun gnas pa'i dge slong dag so sor bros nas kha cig ni mnyan yod du song ngo /kha cig ni gnas gzhan dang gzhan du song ngo / /skabs der sbyor ba 'chang ba dudang / blon po gzhan rnams dang / kau shāsbyi rtson gnas pa'i mi'i gtso bo dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyis ku cho skuzhi bar byas te de nas sbyor ba 'chang gis ji ltar rgyal po ra ba'i khar song ngo 'u/ /ji ltar ra ba'i drung na khyi 'dug par gyur ces kun tu brtag par brtsams so/ /des de ltar brtags tsupa dang / nor lhas byin gyis ji ltar thabs kyis bsad pa rtsad sachod de de khros nas nor lhas byin rgya skyegs 9kyi khang par bcug ste bsregs so/ /dge slong dag the tshom 0skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa rgyal po shar ba'i bus las ci zhig bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin nyu)pas khyi dag gis 'tshal te dus las 'das lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rgyal po sashar ba'i bu nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba 'ong ba bzhin du nye bar gnas pa gdon mi za bar 'byung bar shu tre'agyur ba dag byas shing bsags te/ dge slong dag rgyal po shar ba'i bus las byas shing bsags pa dag cigazhan sus so sor nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la chesmin 6par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la ma yin/ me'i khams la ma yin/ rlung gi khams la ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las byas pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dag kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ bskal pa 11—12

brgya phrag rnams su yang / /las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /lus can rnams la 'bras bur smin ①/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri 'or ②zhig na bram ze mdun na 'don zhig 'dug go/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa na rang sangs rgyas phongs pa dang / dman pa la thugs brtse ba she/ bas mtha'i gnas mal rtsedag la dga' ba/ sbyin gnas gcig pur gyur pa dag 'jig rten du 'byung bas rang sangs rgyas shig ljongs rgyu ba rgyu zhing ri 'or phyeder phyin pa dang / phyogs zhig tu nub mo gnas so/ /de phyi de nyin rtsosnga dro sham thothabs dang chos gos bgos lhung bzed thogs nas ri 'or ghugyi grong thoder bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang / mdun na 'don de yang khyi khrid nas phyir byung ste/ des rang sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po nyes pa med cing gnod pa mi byed pa de la khyi sbad do/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/mdun na 'don gang skyeyin pa de ni rgyal po shar ba'i bu 'di yin te/ 'dis tsunye de'i tshe de'i dus na rang sangs rgyas nyes pa med cing gnod pa mi byed pa la khyi sbad pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas tshe rabs lnga brgyar khyis zos nas dus las 'das te/ da ltar gyi bar du yang khyis zos te dus las 'das par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las rtegacig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu gnag gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi yang gcig tu dkar / 'dren ma rnams kyi yang 'dren ma ste/ dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa dang / 'dren ma rnams spangs nas las gcig tu dkar ba dag kho na la brtsal bar byas te④/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong 11—13

de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis lhagasungs pa la yi ②rangs te mngon par bstod do/ /rgyal po shar ba'i bu dus las 'das nas rgyal po gtum po (rgyarab snang 'gran zla med par rgyal po byed par gyur to/ /de dus gzhan zhig na khang bzangs kyi ④steng du byung nas blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor te gtam bzang po ma yin pa dag zer zhing 'khod des/ shes ldan dag grong dang grong khyer dang gnas gang na smad 'tshong ma bzang mo yod/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha rdo 'jog na smad 'tshong ma bzang mo zhes bgyi ba gzugs dang na tshod dang / ldan pa sgyu 'urtsal drug bcu 3rtsa bzhi la mkhas pa zhig mchis te/ ldumathong ma thag tu chags par mi 'gyur ba'i mi gang lags pa de ni sa'i steng na 'ga' yang ma mchis so/ /rgyal po gtum po rab snang gis de'i gzugs dang na tshod thodang ldan pa thos nas thos ma thag tu chags par gyur te smras pa/ gsos pa ci byas kyang mi phan de lta bu'i bud med la dga' mgur spyad dgos pas rdo 'jog tu song ste de dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad par bya'o/ /des smras pa lha rgyal po pad ma'i snying po tshi can ni yun ring po nas khyod kyi gshed mar gyur pa/ phyir rgol bar gyur pa/ mi mdza' bar gyur pa lags la/ de ni rtag tu rdo 'jog na mchis /1lags pas ci 6ste lha nyuX rdo 'jog tu gshegs na gdon mi 'tshal bar des lha brlag par bgyid lags so/ /des smras pa/ mi rnams kyi conang na mi gzu lums can dag lta yod mod kyi/ 'on kyang khyod ni 'di la 8'dug shig⑩ /nga ni 'gro'o/ /des smras pa/ ci ⑩ste lha de lta bur dgyes na lha nyid mkhyen mod kyi/ 'on kyang bag mdzad pa'i rigs so/ /rgyal po rab snang bud med la brkam chags can yin pas des de'i tshig ma mnyan nas glang po che'i gtso bo 'dam bu'i ri la zhon te rdo 11—14

'jog tu song ngo / /de rim gyis song nas gtun shing ri la phyin ①pa dang /des der glang po che'i gtso bo 'dam bu'i ri bzhag nas rdo 'jog tu song ngo / /de nas mu tig gi dudo shal srang brgya stong ri ba mgul nas bkrol te bzang mo gzugs kyis 'tsho ba'i gan du song nas de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /'phags rgyal na gnas pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rdudag shes ldan dag rgyal po mi snang na gar bzhud ces dpyod pa la zhugs pa dang / de na kha cig gis smras pa/ de ci mi byaphal pa yin nam/ des na rgyami mngon mngon ༅par 2'gyur du zad kyi/ de gar yang ni ma bzhud do/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ de ni btsun mo'i 'khor rgya che ba yin pas ci'i phyir phyi rol du 'byung ste/ btsun mo'i 'khor nyid na dga' ba dang rtsed mo so sor nyams su myong bar byed do/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ 'di la the tshom byar ci yod/ tshur sheg gsos pa la 'drir 'dong ngo phyo/ /kha cig gis legs kyis 6de ltar bya'o zhes smras nas de dag thams cad 'dus te gsos pa'i drung du dong nas smras pa/ gsos pa lha mi snang na ga shed du ma bzhud grang /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci rings mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis smras pa/ gsos pa ji srid skyon mthong bar 'gyur/ des smras pa/ lo bcu gnyis lon nas so/ /de dag khros nas smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir de skad smra ba skyolas na gdon mi za bar khyod kyis lha bsad nas bdag nyid rgyal srid byed par 'dod do/ /de'i phyir re zhig gal te zhag bdun na lha ltar tsoyod na de lta na 8legs ji ste med na ni nged kyis gzhan zhig rgyal por dbang bskur bar bya'o zhes byas pa dang / de cang mi zer bar lag pa 'gram pa la gtad de 11—15

sems khong du ②chud cing 'dug pa ②ba lang skyong gi ma zhi bas thos nas ②bos te dris pa/ gsos pa khyod ci'i phyir lag pa 'gram pa la gtad de ④sems khong du ⑤chud cing 'dug /des smras pa/ lha mo bram ze dag 'di skad ces mchi na ji ltar sems khong du phyechud cing mi mchis/ des smras pa/ gsos pa gal te de lta rtson song la nas kyi chas mar dang sbrang rtsis bskus pa gser snod kyi nang du lugs dute/ rta mang lag la rgyus rtsapa gang yin pa de'i mdun du zhog la 'di skad ces gang zhig nged co nyid rdo 'jog tu 'gro bar spro ba de tsonas kyi chas mar dang sbrang rtsis bskus pa 'di dag zo shig ces smros la de ltar bya ste 8rta bzang po gang gis zos pa nged tsal sbron cig /gsos pas ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin du byas na 'ga' 0yang za bar spro ba med do/ /phyogs gzhan zhig na rta rid rke ba lus rmya bar gyur pa/ ngan ma za ba/ dbugs rgod pa/ rna ba mchag pa zhig 'dug skyepa de'i drung du de song ste mdun du 'dug nas/ gang zhig nged ④nyid rdo 'jog tu 'gro bar spro ba de nas kyi chas mar dang skosbrang rtsis bskus pa 'di dag zo shig ces smras pa dang / des de dag zos so/ /gsos pa nyunyesong nas/ ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba la ji ltar gyur pa smras pa dang / des smras pa/ gsos pa song la stod gye cig /gal te stod hu pa'i tshe mi srun byed na khyod kyis ma 'jigs par dpung dunaskyed cig /sems stobs dang ldan pa la ni sus kyang mi rdzi'o/ /de song nas de bstad 3par brtsams pa dang / de stod ④pa'i tshe rab tu 'jigs pa chen po'i gzugs su bdag nyid sprul nas/ kwa'i ④mi khyod kyis sngon 0chad 'di lta bu'i rta mthong ba 'ga' yod dam zhes smras 0so/ /des tsoral gri shubs nas phyung ste bsdigs nas kwa'i porta'i srin po khyod kyis sngon chad rta zhon pa su la 11—16

yang lcag 'di ①lta bu mthong ba yod dam zhes smras pa dang / des smras pa/ kye mi sngon ma mthong ngo / /des kye rta'i srin po gal te re zhig mi srun mi byed na de lta na legs/ ci ②ste byed na mgo drungs nas bcad de sa la dor bar bya'o/ /des smras pa/ kye mi ci ①ste de lta na gal te bdag phyir 'dir khrid de mi 'ong bar dam 'cha' na 'gro'o/ /des smras pa/ legs kyis ④de bzhin dus ⑤byas 'dod do zhes smras nas/ des de la zhon te song nas rim gyis ⑥rdo 'jog tu phyin to/ /rgyal po gtum po ⑦rab snang gis mthong nas smras pa/ gsos pa 'ongs sam/ des smras pa/ lha mchis so/ /dgos pa ci zhig gi phyir zhes byas pa dang / des ji ltar gyur pa ⑧rnams brjod do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/gsos pa re zhig zhag bdun gyi bar du rtses ⑨la zhag bdun 'das pa dang dus shes par bya'o/ /zhes byas nas zhag bdun gyi bar du gzugs kyis 'tsho ba bzang mo dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad de zhag bdun 'das nas song ngo / /gtun shing rir phyin nas bdag nyid kyis glang po che'i gtso bo 'dam bu'i ri bstad par brtsams pa dang / des bstad pa na skad phyung ba/ de dang mi ring ba zhig na bram ze ltas mkhan long ba zhig gnas pa des thos nas/ des smras pa/glang po che'i gtso bo 'di'i skad dang sbyar na/ 'di ni 'di nas dpag tshad brgyar song nas lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po las chu 'thung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po rab snang dang gsos pa glang po che'i gtso bo 'dam bu'i ri la zhon te song ngo / /re zhig cig na phyogs zhig na rdza mkhan zhig 'dug pa de'i snod so ma btang ba dag cig 'dam bu'i ri'i rkang pas brdzis tshunas rdza mkhan gyis mya ngan bya bar brtsams pa dang / gsos pas smras pa/ gang dag sas 'tsho ba de dag 11—17

ni 'di ltar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po rnams ni khā bzhin khu 'phrig za ba yin pas rgyal po rab snang gis bsams pa/ gsos pa 'di bdag la zur za ste/ de ①ci bdag gcig pu sas 'tsho ba yin nam mjal ②sto snyam du bsams nas cang mi zer bar song ngo / /yang phyogs zhig na thing ③ril gyis lam kur 0tshang bcas pa de'i sgo ⑤nga dag 'dam bu'i ri'i rkang pas bcom nas 0des kyang mya ngan bya bar brtsams pa dang / gsos pas smras pa/ gang dag spyod yul ma yin par spyod pa de dag ni 'di ltar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po rab snang de bzhin du rtog ⑦pa skyes nas bsams pa/ yang 'di bdag la zur za ste/ ci smad 'tshong ma bdag gi spyod yul ma yin nam mjal lato snyam du bsams nas cang mi zer bar song ngo / /yang 'dam bu'i ri shing drung na mar song ba dang / shing de'i yal ga la sbrul zhig gnas pa des bsnyabs nas rgyal po rab snang bza' bar brtsams so / /re zhig na gsos pas mthong nas des de ral gri shubs nas phyung ste dum bu dum bur gtubs nas sa la bor ba dang g.yo zhing 'gul ba gsos pas bltas te smras pa/ gang dag don du gnyer bar bya ba ma yin pa don du gnyer ba de dag ni 'di 0ltar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po rab snang de kho na bzhin du rtog pa skyes nas bsams pa/ 'di bdag la lan gsum gyi bar du zur za ste/ ci smad 'tshong ma bdag gis don du gnyer bar bya ba ma yin nam mjal 0to snyam du bsams nas cang mi zer bar song ngo / /dus gzhan zhig na 'dam bu'i ri bang theg 0ste song nas/ rgyal pos de bzung ba dang ma thub nas gsos patsha smras pa/lha bram ze ltas mkhan gyis 'di dpag tshad brgyar song nas lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po las chu 'thung bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan gyi 8de'i slad du myur du shing 11—18

gi yal ga la 'jus te glang po che thong shig ces byas pa dang / des myur ba myur bar ①shing gi yal ga la 'jus so/ /gsos pas kyang shing gi yal ga la 'jus pa dang 'dam bu'i ri 'das te song ngo / /rgyal pos gsos pa la smras pa/gsos pa song la ma tshor bar zhi ba la lha ni byon nas skyed ②mos tshal na bzhugs so//zhes gyis shig /de song nas de la brjod pa dang / de dga' ba skyes nas cang mi zer bar 'dug go/ /rgyal pos kyang stor khung nas 'dzul bar brtsams pa las/ re zhig na bu mo gnyis shig bshang rgyasar byung ba dang / de na gcig rjogis smras pa/ grogs mo lha 'ongs so zhes grarge 0go/ /cig ༅shos kyis de stor khung nas 'dzul lo zhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos thos nas des bsams pa/gsos pa la ⑦bdag gis khyod kyis ma tshor bar nizhi ba la smros shig ces bsgo na des khyim na 'dug pa ril la smras so snyam du bsams te de khros nas des gsos pa la ⑨ji ltar gyur pa dran par byas nas klan 0ka btsal ba/ gsos pa khyod ko nga la gnod pa byed par zhugs pa lta nga gcig pu sas 'tsho ba yin nam/ ci na gang gi phyir khyod ying la phyogs che ge mo zhig tu gang dag sas 'tsho ba de dag ni 'di ltar 'gyur ro zhes zur za/ smad 'tshong ma nga'i spyod yul ma yin nam ci na yang phyogs zhig tu gang dag spyod yul ma yin par spyod 8pa de dag ni 'di ltar 'gyur ro zhes zur za/ smad 'tshong ma ngas don du gnyer bar bya ba ma yin nam ci na yang phyogs zhig tu yang gang dag don du gnyer bar bya ba ma yin pa don du gnyer ba de dag 0'di ltar 8'gyur ro zhes zur za/ da gzod kyang nga skyed ⑫mos tshal na 'dug pas khyod song la ma tshor bar zhi ba la lha byon te skyed tsomos tshal na bzhugs so zhes gyis shig ces bsgo bsgo na/ khyod kyis 0khyim na 8'dug 11—19

pa ril la smras pas khyod ni nga la gnod pa byed par zhugs so/ /de dogs shing mi dga' nas yid ches par bya ba'i phyir smras pa/ lha sdig pas ni brlag ①ste bdag gis lha la zur bgyis pa ma mchis so/ /bdag gis lha la ji ltar zur bgyis / lha 'di skad du gnas che ge mo zhig tu khyod kyis zung la gang dag sas 'tsho ba de dag ni 'di ltar 'gyur ro zhes zur byas so zhes gsung ba gang lags pa ni phyogs der rdza mkhan gyi snod so ma btang dub dag cig 'dam bu'i ri'i rkang pas brdzis nas rdza mkhan des mya ngan bgyi bar brtsams pa dang / bdag gis de las bsams nas/ 'di skad du gang dag sas 'tsho ④ba de dag ni 'di ltar 'gyur ro zhes bgyis parasabs so/ /phyogs che ge mo zhig tu khyod kyis nga la gang dag spyod yul ma yin par spyod pa de dag ni 'di ltar 'gyur ro zhes zur byas so zhes gsung ba skyogang lags pa ni phyogs der srog chags thing rtsoril gyi sgo zhung dag cig /'dam bu'i ri'i rkang pas bcom nas de yang mya ngan byed par brtsams pa dang / bdag gis de las bsams nas 'di skad du gang dag spyod yul ma yin par spyod pa de dag ni 'di ltar 'gyur ro zhes bgyis par bas so/ /phyogs che ge mo zhig tu khyod kyis nga nyu snal gang dag don du gnyer ba ma yin pa don du gnyer ba de dag ni 'di ltar 'gyur ro zhes zur byas so zhes gsung ba gang lags pa ni phyogs der shing gi yal ga la sbrul zhig gnas pa des bsnyabs skyonas lha bza' bar brtsams pa dang / bdag gis 8ral gri shubs nas phyung ste dum bu dum bur bcad nas de sa la lhung ba dang / bdag gis de las bsams nas/'di skad du gang dag tsodon du gnyer bar bya ba ma ④yin pa don du gnyer ba de dag ni 'di ltar 'gyur ro zhes bgyis par bas so/ /ngas khyod la ma tshor bar 11—20

zhi ba la lha skyed ①mos tshal na bzhugs so zhes gyis shig ces byas na khyod kyis ②khyim na gnas pa ril la smras so zhes gsung ba tshigang lags pa de yang bdag gis ma tshor ba kho nar zhi ba la thubagyis na bdag ji ltar lha la gnod pa bgyid par zhugs pa lags/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa khyod kyis nga la lan 3thams cad legs par glan na/ da gzod nga stor zhukhung nas 'dzul ba na nga bdag nyid kyis bud med gnyis shig las gcig thogis grogs mo lha dubyon to zhes grag go zhes byas pa dang / cig 2shos na re de stor khung nas 'dzul lo zhes zer ba thos na de sus byas zhig gu lha de dag ni phra men ma lags na lags skyo kyang 'tshal mod / der yang bdag gis lha la gnod pa ma bgyis so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/gsos pa khyod kyis tunyeji skad smras pa de de lta nyu)yin mod kyi ngas khyod bgams skyopar zad kyis sami dga' bar ma byed cig /'on kyang nga rdo 'jog tu song ba'i tshe bram ze 6gang dag gis gzhan zhig rgyal por dbang bskur bar brtsams pa de dag thag gzhug pa'i dus 'di skyeyin pas de rnams gsad rtsopar bya'o/ /des smras pa/ lha bram ze rnams re zhig gzhag tu gsol/ phra nyunyemen ma de rnams nyusheje dgum par bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa de rnams ji ltar gsad du par nus/ lha byabadag gis de rnams khums pa'i thabs zhig bgyi'o/ /gsos pa legs kyis 3de bzhin du gyis shig ces byas pa dang / gsos pas mdun na 'don gyi khye'u rig sngags smra ba mkhas pa zhig yod pa de'i drung du song nas bu phra tsomen ma 'di dag skye bo mang po gsod par byed na/ de dag gzung 'bar bya ba'i thabs de 'ga' yod dam zhes smras pa dang / des smras pa/ yab ci bgyir mchis bdag gis gzung bar bas so/ /bu legs so zhes byas pa dang / des 11—21

mi'i lag pa las kyi.ut+pal 'dra bar bsgyur nas mi'i lag tu bskur te 0smras pa/kye mi khyod song la sung du phyin nas 'dug la/ su rin gyis nyo ba de la ma sbyin par gang zhig mthong na dgod dus de'i ming dris te glegs bu la bris shig /des de thogs te 'dug nas gang zhig rin gyis nyo ba de la mi ster/ gang zhig mthong nas dgod ④pa de'i ming ni dris nas glegs bu la 'dri skyebar byed de⑥/des de ltar 'phags rgyal gyi phra ④men ma lnga brgya'i ming dris nas bris so/ /de nas gsos pa la bstan nas gsos pas kyang rgyal po la bstan pa dang / rgyal pos smras pathu/ gsos pa phra skyemen ma tsamang po 'di dag ci ltar kha btagaskye /des smras pa/ lha de rnams ji ltar dgum nyusnyepa'i thabs bdag la 6'tshal gyis rtso lha thugs khral bskyud du blagasol/ des smras pa/ gsos pa legs te khyod nyid shes so/ /des 'phags rgyal gyi phyogs zhig tu 'khor gyi khyams zhig byas nas / des lha ni ma'i chudam tshig la 'jug gis bya'aphags rgyal na srin nyu8mo ji snyed gnas pa thams cad 'khor gyi khyams su 'du bar gyis shig ces dril bsgrags pa dang / de dag gis bsams pa/ lha 'khor gyi khyams su ma'i /rkyedam tshig la 'jug pa der bdag cag la rdzas bzang po mang du ster gyis ri kā 'gro bar bya'o snyam nas gang dag mi mngon par 'dug 'dug pa de dag kyang rnyed pa la chags pas bdag nyid nye bar bstan te srin ༅mo lnga brgya lhag tsam 'khor gyi khyams su lhags so/ /de nas mdun na 'don gyi bu 3des de dag thams cad rig sngags kyi zhags pas bcings pa dang / gsos pas kyang de rnams kha btag 'go/ /rgyal pos 'phags rgyal na gnas pa'i bram ze rnams bos nas shes ldan dag bugis phra 3men ma 'di snyed cig bsad pas bsod nams 0ma yin 11—22

pa mang po bskyed kyis/ khyod nyukyis bdag 'khor ba'i dgon pa de las dbyung ba'i phyir nyin gcig rngubazhin 'khor gyi khyams su 'du zhing zan zo shig duces bsgo ba dang / de rnams kyis shis pa brjod pa byas nas khas blangs so/ /rgyal po rab snang gis sgo rngub la bsgo ba/ kye skyes bu bram ze ji snyed cig 'khor gyi khyams su zan zos nas 'gro ba de dag thams cad khyod kyis legs par grongs te nga la stod cig /des smras pa/ lha de ltar bgyi 5ste gsol bar 'tshal lo /rgyal pos blon po rnams la yang bsgo ba shes ldan dag 'phags rgyal na gnas pa'i bram ze ji snyed cig 'khor gyi khyams su zan za ba thams cad la kha zas bsod pa phal cher byin cig /bram ze rnams ni phal cher lto mdun 'ucan yin pas rgyal po des de ltar byed du bcug go zhes thos nas thams cad lhags tsunas zan bza' bar brtsams so/ /de rnams zan zos nas 'khor gyi khyams nas phyir byung ba dang / sgo bas bgrangs na tsulhag chad med par bram ze brgyad khri byung ste/des thorgyal po la lha lhag chad ma mchis par bram ze brgyad khri mchis so zhes gsol to / /rgyal pos gang gis na 'di rnams dus gcig tu mgo bcad sapa'i thabs de gang yin snyam du bsams nas des zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la bsgo ba/ bram ze zan za ba re re'i rgyab tu gshed ma mi ral gri thogs pa re re zhog la/ gang gi tshe ngas zho 'on cig ces smras pa de'i tshe thams cad kyi skyemago chod cig /rgyal po gtum po rab 8snang gis de ltar byas pa dang / 'phags rgyal na gnas pa'i bram ze rnams las 'chi bdag gi skyozhags pas zin pa brgyad khri tham pa 'khor gyi khyams su 'dus pa de dag sbyor ba des cig ④car mgo bcad do/ /de blan 'phags rgyal na gnas pa'i bram ze las 0bram ze brgyad khri rgyal po rab snang gis ⑩ 11—23

bsad do/ /des de dag bsad nas nub mo mal chen por nyal ba na rmi lam du sa bla'i sgra drug dang / bar snang gi sgra drug ni thos/ rmi lam rnam ①pa brgyad ni mthong ngo / /sa bla'i sgra drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ drug /med/bdag /ngan/ sems/ bdag cag 'di rnams zhes ⑧bya ba ste/ 'di dag ni 'dir tshigs su bcad pa drug gi yi ge dang po yin no/ /de la drug ces bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ lo ni stong phrag drug bcu shedang / /lo ni brgya phrag drug bcu ru/ /sems can dmyal bar 'tshed rnams kyi/ /nam zhig mthar ni phyin par 'gyur④/ /med ces bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ mtha' med mtha' lta zhug la yod/ /nga dang khyed cag nyid ༅kyis ni/ /mtha' nyid dmigs par mi 'gyur ba/ /de ltar sdig pa'i las byas so/ /bdag ces bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ bdag cag gis ni longs spyod dag /mthun tho dang mi mthun 3pas bsgrubs pa/ /gzhan dag bde bas dga' byed kyi/ /bdag cag sdug bsngal skal can gyuranyu/ /ngan 0zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ 'di na bdag cag 'tsho ba ngan/ /bdag cag gang bdog de ma btang //longs spyod dag ni yod pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid la ni phan ma byas/ /sems zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ sems kyis su ni bslus gyur cing / /mi shes pas /khyeni bdas 6gyur pa/ /sems can dmyal bar skyes rnams kyis ⑫/ /gnya' ni su zhig byed par gyur skye/ / bdag cag skye'adi rnams zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ bdag cag 'di rnams bde 'gro ru/ /song ste dge ba mang byas nas/ /de nas bsod nams byas gyur cing / /shis pas tsobyas rnams mtho ris 'dong ⑩/ /bar 8snang gi sgra drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/11—24

thams cad/ su/ gang / da ni/ de rnams/ 'di dag ces bya ba ste/'di dag ni tshigs su bcad pa drug gi 0yi ge dang po yin no/ /de la thams cad ces bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ thams cad gsog tu phyung zin te/ /'di la snying po tsam zhig lus/ /rgyal po srin te ④snying po la/ /dga' ba med pas re dzub bor/ /su zhes bya ba las ④tshigs su bcad pa ni/ su zhig gnyer dulen tshul ngan po'i/ /mig ya gcig yokyang 'jor byed pa/ /des ni bdag gi n+tubu tsha dang / /bdag kyang sdug bsngal las thar byas/ /gang zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ rdzing 'di nya dang rus nisbal ni/ /mang po dag gis gang ba las/ /da nyuni sbal bas 'tsho mod kyi/ /bdag gis gnas ni mi 'dor ro / /da ni zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ gang zhig ri bo gtum ldan la/ /bdag la rkang pas nom byed pa'i/ /long ba nyon mongs de dag ni/ /da ni mgon yang med par gyur/ /de rnams zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/de rnams mtsho ni bzang po las/ /chu ni bsil zhing zhim pa dag /bde blag nyid du rnyed par 'gyur/ /bdag kyang da skyeltar der dga'o/ /'di dag ces bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ 'di dag khrus byas zos nas ni/ /phyogs dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /bdag ni rnyi ༅yis bzung gyur pa/ /sngon go rkyesdig pa ci zhig byas/ /rmi lam brgyad ces bya ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tsan dan dkar pos lus byugs 0pa dang / tsan dan dmar pos gtor ba dang /klad ④la me 'bar ba dang / mchan khung gnyis nas sbrul gnyis 'phyang ba dang /rkang pa gnyis la nya khar ba gnyis ldag pa dang / ngang pa gnyis nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / ri nag po zhig mdun na tshur 'ong ba dang / chu skyar dag 11—25

mgo la rtug pas 'thor ba mthong ngo / /de gnyid sad nas 'jigs par gyur①/bag tsha bar gyur cing spu zing zhes byed nas gzhi 'di las bdag rgyal srid las nyams pa'am/ srog gi chabar chad du mi 'gyur grang snyam mo/ /des rmi lam de dag bram ze rmi lam gyi dpyad shes pa gang dag yin pa de dag bos te bsnyad pa dang / de dag gis bsams pa/ lhas rmi lam de dag bzang po zhig mthong mod kyi 'on kyang bsngags par ni mi bya ste/ gal te bsngags na 'di ji lta ba ②ngan par gyur nas bram ze lhag ma gang dag yin pa de dag kyang ma lus par byed par 'ong ngo snyam du rig nas gros byas te smras pa/ lha rmang bulam ni mi bzang ba ⑤dag cig go/ /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag ༅'bras bu cir 'gyur/ de dag gis smras pa/ gzhi de las lha rgyal srid las nyams pa'am/ srog gi bar chad du 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang gis thong rgyal srid las kyang nyams par mi 'gyur zhing srog gi bar chad du yang mi 'gyur ba'i thabs de lta 'ga' yod dam/ de dag gis smras pa/ lha khyod kyis sdig duchen po byas te bram ze brgyad khri bsad pas de'i slad du gal te spyod na thabs gcig cig mchis sol/ /de bram ze bsad pa dran nas snying kun tu 'dar te smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci bya smros shig /de dag gis smras pa/ lha skyed klumos tshal du rdzing bu rkor rtsostsal te/ brkos ⑨nas rdo thal gyi 8nyug tu stsol cig /de nas der yan lag gi mchog lnga po gsos pa dang / mdun na 'don dang / ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba dang / skya bseng gi bu mo sgrol ma dang / gzhon nu ba lang skyong rnams bsad de bcug la de rnams kyi khrag gis khrus mdzad de rdzing bu nas byung la pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs tsonas bram ze rnams kyi rkang pa la lces bldags nas8/11—26

de lta na khyod rgyal srid las kyang nyams par mi 'gyur zhing / srog gi bar chad du yang mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/ gal te bdag gis yan lag gi mchog lnga po ①gsos pa dang / mdun na 'don dang / ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba dang / skya bseng ②gi bu mo sgrol ma dang / gzhon nu ba lang skyong rnams bsad na ②bdag rgyal po byas te yang ci rung snyam du bsams nas bram ze rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed kyis gang smras pa de ngas thos kyis ④deng shig dang re zhig bsams te bya'o/ /bram ze rnams dong ba dang de lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas sems khong du ⑤chud cing 'dug pa ba lang skyong gi ma zhi bas mthong ste des smras pa/ lha ci'i slad du phyag 'gram pa la gtad de sems khong du ༅chud cing bzhugs/ des ji ltar gyur pa thams cad de la bsnyad nyupa dang / des smras pa/ lha bram ze de dag ni rtag tu mi rigs pa bsten ⑧pa lags pas de dag ci 'tshal/ bzhud la ⑨'phags pa ka t+ya'i byabu chen po la zhus shig /des smras pa/ zhi ba legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis dus su 'phags pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po la gtad pas 'gro'o zhes tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu ga la ba der song ngo / /thormeder song ste song nas tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas rgyal po gtum po rab snang gis tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po la tso'adi skad ces smras so/ /slob dpon ka t+ya'i bu chen po 'di na bdag mtshan mo mal chen po zhig na nyal zhing mchis pa'i tshe rmi lam du sa bla'i sgra drug dang / bar snang gi sgra drug ni thos/ rmi lam brgyad ni mthong ste/ sa bla'i sgra drug gang zhe na / 'di lta ste/ drug /med/ bdag /ngan/ sems/ bdag 11—27

cag 'di rnams zhes bya ba ste/ 'di dag ni 'dir tshigs su bcad pa drug gi yi ge dang po lags so/ /de la drug ces bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ lo ni stong phrag drug bcu dang / /lo ni brgya phrag drug bcu ru/ /sems can dmyal bar 'tshed rnams kyi/ /nam zhig mthar ni phyin par 'gyur/ /med ces bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ mtha' med mtha' lta ga la yod/ /nga dang khyed cag nyid 2kyis ni/ /mtha' nyid dmigs par mi 'gyur ba/ /de ltar sdig pa'i las byas so/ /bdag ces bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ bdag cag gis ni longs spyod dag /mthun rgyadang mi mthun ⑧pas bsgrubs pa/ /gzhan dag bde bas dga' byed kyi/ /bdag cag sdug bsngal skal can gyur/ /ngan zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ 'di na bdag cag 'tsho ba ngan/ /bdag cag gang bdog de ma btang / /longs spyod dag ni yod pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid la ni phan ma byas/ /sems zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/sems kyis su ni bslus gyur cing / /mi shes pas ni bdas gyur pa/ /sems can dmyal bar skyes rnams kyi/ /gnya' ni su zhig byed par 'gyur/ / bdag cag ④'di rnams zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ bdag cag 'di rnams bde 'gro ru/ /song ste dge ba mang byas nas/ /de nas bsod nams byas gyur cing / /shis pa byas rnams mtho ris 'dong / /bar snang gi sgra drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ thams cad/ su/ gang / da ni/ de rnams/'di dag ces bya ba ste/ 'di dag ni tshigs su bcad pa drug gi yi ge dang po lags so/ /de la thams cad ces bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ thams cad gsog tu phyung zin te⑤/ /de la snying po tsam zhig lus/ /rgyal po srin te 11—28

snying po la①/ /dga' ba med pas re ba bor/ /su zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ su zhig gnyer ②len tshul ngan po'i/ /mig ya gcig kyang 'jor byed pa/ /des ni bdag gi bu tsha dang / /bdag kyang sdug bsngal las thar ②byas/ /gang zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ rdzing 'di nya dang rus ④sngal ni/ /mang po dag gis gang ba las/ /da ni sbal bas 'tsho mod kyi/ /bdag gis gnas ni mi 'dor ro/ /da ni zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/gang zhig ri bo gtum sduldan la/ /bdag la rkang pas rnam byed pa'i/ /long ba nyon mongs de dag ni/ /da ni mgon yang med par 'gyur/ /de rnams zhes bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ de rnams mtsho ni bzang po las/ /chu ni bsil zhing zhim pa dag /bde blag nyid du rnyed par 'gyur/ /bdag kyang da ltar der dga'o/ /'di dag ces bya ba las tshigs su bcad pa ni/ 'di dag khrus byas zos nas ni/ /phyogs dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /bdag ni rnyi byuciyis bzung gyur pa/ /sngon go ④sdig pa ci zhig byas/ /rmi lam brgyad ces bya ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tsan dan dkar pos lus byugs pa dang / tsan dan dmar pos gtor ba dang / klad rdul me 'bar ba dang / mchan khung gnyis nas sbrul gnyis 'phyang ba dang / rkang pa gnyis la nya khar ba gnyis ldag pa dang / ngang pa gnyis nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / ri nag po zhig mdun nas 0tshur 'ong ba dang / chu skyar dag mgo la rtug pas 'thor ba mthong ste / gnyid sad nas 'jigs par gyur⑩/ bag tsha bar gyur cing spu zing zhes bgyid nas/ gzhi 'di las bdag rgyal srid las nyams pa'am/ srog gi bar chad du mi 'gyur grang snyam bgyid do/ /'phags pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po la 11—29

bdag don 'di zhu na/ gzhi 'di las bdag rgyal srid las nyams pa'am/ srog gi bar chad du mi 'gyur ba ①lags grang / tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i ③bu chen pos smras pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis sgra de dag dang / rmi lam de dag gzhan 'ga' zhig la bsnyad dam/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa bsnyad do/ /su zhig la / bram ze rnams la'o/ /de dag gis khyod la ji skad du lung bstan/ des ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par bsnyad pa dang / des smras pa/ rgyal po chen po de dag ni rtag tu 'dod pa la longs spyod ⑧pa dang / lha'i 'jig rten mngon par 'dod pa yin te/ de dag ci shes/ khyod kyis sgra bzang po dag cig kyang thos/rmi lam bzang po dag cig kyang mthong gisabya/ khyod ma 'jigs shig dang / gzhi de las khyod rgyal srid las zhunyams par yang mi 'gyur/ srog gi bar chad skyodu yang mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i ④phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis dumi lam na sa bla'i rngasgra drug thos pa gang yin pa de gang gi ④ltas yin zhe na/ khyod kyi mdun rol gyi rgyal po drug cig gis chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed du bcug pas lus zhig nas sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skyes so// //'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/ bam po nyi shu nyunyedagu pa/ de na gcig gis sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen nas tshigs su bcad pa/ lo ni stong phrag drug bcu dang / /lo ni brgya phrag drug bcu ru/ /sems can dmyal bar 'tshed rnams kyis / /nam zhig mthar ni phyin 8par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba smras so/ /gnyis pas tshigs su bcad pa/ mtha' med mtha' lta ga la yod / /nga dang khyed cag gnyis ④kyis ni/ /mtha' nyid dmigs par mi 'gyur ba/ /de ltar sdig pa'i las byas so/ /zhes bya ba smras so/ /gsum 11—30

pas tshigs su bcad pa/ bdag cag gis ni longs spyod dag /mthun ①dang mi mthun ②pas bsgrubs pa/ /gzhan dag bde bas dga' byed kyi/ /bdag cag sdug bsngal skal ②can gyur/ /ces bya ba smras so/ /bzhi pas tshigs su bcad pa/ 'di na bdag cag 'tsho ba ngan/ /bdag cag gang bdog de ma btang / /longs spyod dag ni yod pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid la ni phan ma ④byas/ /zhes bya ba smras so/ /lnga pas tshigs su bcad pa/ sems kyis su ⑤ni bslus gyur cing / /mi shes pas ni bdas gyur pa/ /sems can dmyal bar skyes rnams kyi/ /gnya' ni su zhig byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba smras so/ /drug pas tshigs su bcad pa/ bdag cag 'di rnams bde 'gro ru/ /song ste dge ba mang byas nas/ /de nas bsod nams byas gyur cing ⑥/ /shis pa byas rnams mtho ris 'dong / /zhes bya ba smras te/ de dag ni de'i ltas yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis bar snang las sgra drug thos pa gang yin pa de gang gi ltas yin zhe natho/ khyod kyi khyim gyi gdung ma de la srin bu zhig gnas pa des de'i snying po ma yin pa thams cad zos nas snying po nyi zhutshe lus pa dang / de der ⑨mngon par the )mi dga' nas tshigs su bcad pa/ thams cad gsog tu phyung zin te/ /'di la snying po tsam zhig lus/ /rgyal po srin de snying po la/ /dga' ba med pas re ba bor/ /zhes lha/smras so/ /nam mkha'i sgra dang po ni de yin te/ de bas na khyod kyis phyung la gdung gzhan zhig chug shigatso /rgyal po chen po gzhan yang khyod kyi rta rdzi gnyer tshulen zhes bya ba des bya rog mo'i ④sgo nga byung zhing byung ba rnams bcom pa dang / de bu dang bral bas yid mi tshubade ba skyes te/ snying rje rje skad du ngu zhing dal bus tshigs su bcad pa/ su zhig gnyer ⑫11—31

len tshul ngan po'i/ /mig ya gcig kyang 'jor byed pa/ /des ni bdag gi bu tsha dang / /bdag kyang sdug bsngal las thar byas/ /zhes bya ba smras te/nam mkha'i sgra gnyis pa ni de yin gyisal/ /khyod kyis de 'joms su ma gzhug shig ge /gzhan yang khyod kyi khyim na rtse ba'i rdzing bu bya rog gis btung slebs tsam du chus kha da chad ②du gang ba nya dang / rus ④sngal dang / sbal ba mang po gnas pa de na chu skyar gcig cig nya dag za zhing 'dug pa las deng skams phyete chu med par gyur pa dang / chu skyar des de lta bu de mthong nas mi dga' ste tshigs su bcad pa/ rdzing 'di nya dang rus ༅sbal ni/ /mang po dag gis gang ba las/ /da ni sbal bas 'tsho mod kyi/ /bdag gis gnas ni mi 'dor ro/ /zhes bya ba smras te/ nam mkha'i sgra gsum pa ni de yin gyis rtsokhyod kyis de chus khong shig /gzhan yang khyod kyi yul na ri bo gtum ldan zhes bya ba de la du glang po che dang glang po che mo dmus long zhig gnas te/ de gnyis la bu gcig 7yod pa de de dag gi rim gro byed do/ /de skyede gnyis kyi zas kyi phyir song ba na 6glang po che mo zhig dang lhan cig 'dus par gyur pa las/ de khyod kyis thabs kyis brongs 6te khrid de 'ongs nas btags nyunyete bzhag pa dang / de ma dang pa'i rjes su mya ngan byed cing rtswa yang mi za chu yang mi 'thung skyobar de dag rjes su dran zhing mi dga' bar gyur nas tshigs su bcad pa/ gang zhig ri bo gtum ldan la/ /bdag la rkang pas rnam byed pa'i/ /long ba nyon mongs de dag ni/ /da skyini mgon yang med par gyur/ /ces bya ba smras te/ nam mkha'i sgra bzhi pa ni de yin gyis②/ pha ma'i grogs byed pa shi na mi rung bas khyod kyis de thong shig /gzhan yang khyod kyi khyim na ri dgas ⑩zhig bzung ste 'dug pa de khyu dang bral chitso11—32

bas dgon pa'i ri dgas rnams dran nas tshigs su bcad pa/ de rnams mtsho ni bzang po las/ /chu ni bsil ①zhing zhim pa dang ②/ /bde blag nyid du rnyed ②par 'gyur/ /bdag kyang da ltar der dga'o/ /zhes bya ba smras te/ bar snang gi sgra lnga pa ni de yin gyis khyod kyis ④de thong shig /gzhan yang khyod kyi ⑤khyim na ngang pa dag cig bzung ste 'dug pa de dag gis ngang pa gnam la 'phur ba dag mthong nas mi dga' ste tshigs su bcad pa/ 'di dag khrus byas zos nas ni/ /phyogs dang phyogs su 'gro bar byed/ /bdag ni rnyi byuyis bzung gyur pa/ /sngon go ④sdig pa ci zhig byas/ /zhes bya ba smras te/ nam mkha'i sgra drug pa ni de yin pas de dag kyang khyod kyis gtang dubar bya ste de ni de dag gi ltas yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis rmi rtsalam brgyad mthong ba gang yin pa de ci'i snga ltas yin zhe na/ re zhig tsan dan dkar pos lus byugs par mthong ba gang yin pa ni khyod la lus 'phags kyi rgyal pos gos be'u ras yug po che zhig skyes su bskur ba lam du zhugs shing 'dug ste de zhag bdun na phyin par 'gyur bas khyod kyi rmi lam dang po ni de'i snga ltas yin no/ /khyod kyis tshulus la tsan dan dmar pos gtor bar mthong ba gang yin pa ni khyod las 'dzin gyi rgyal pos la ba rin po che zhig skyes su bskur ba lam du zhugs shing 'dug ste/ de yang zhag bdun na phyin par 'gyur bas rmi lam gnyis pa ni de'i snga ltas yin no/ /khyod kyis klad ༅pa la me 'bar bar tsomathong ba gang yin pa ni khyod la yul ya ba na'i ⑫rgyal pos gser gyi phreng ba zhig skyes su bskur ba lam du zhugs shing 'dug ste/ de yang zhag bdun na phyin par 'gyur bas rmi lam gsum pa ni de'i snga ltas yin no/ /khyod kyis tsomachan khung gnyis nas sbrul gnyis 'phyang ba mthong ba gang yin pa ni 11—33

khyod la rgya'i rgyal pos ral gri zung cig skyes su bskur ba lam du zhugs shing 'dug ste / de yang zhag bdun na phyin par 'gyur bas khyod kyi rmi lam bzhi pa ni de'i snga ①ltas yin no/ /khyod kyis 0rkang pa gnyis la nya khar ba gnyis ldag pa mthong ba gang yin pa ni khyod la sing ga la'i rgyal pos nor bu'i lham zung cig skyes su bskur ba lam du zhugs shing 'dug ste de yang zhag bdun na phyin par 'gyur bas khyod kyi rmi lam lnga pa ni de'i snga ltas yin no/ /khyod kyis ngang pa gnyis nam mkha' shel 'phur ba mthong ba gang yin pa ni khyod la r+ghaṃ ④ga la'i rgyal pos rta gnyis zhig skyes su bskur ba lam du zhugs shing 'dug ste de yang zhag bdun na phyin par 'gyur bar ⑤khyod kyi yimi lam drug pa ni de'i snga ltas yin no/ /khyod kyis ri nag po zhig mdun nas tshur 'ong ba rtsomathong ba gang yin pa ⑧ni khyod la ka ling ku'i rgyal pos glang po che'i gtso bo zhig skyes su bskur ba lam du zhugs shing 'dug ste de yang zhag bdun na phyin par 'gyur bas khyod kyi rmi lam bdun pa ni de'i snga ltas yin no/ /khyod kyis chu skyar dag mgo la rtug spupas 'thor ba mthong ba rtsogang yin pa de ni khyod dang ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba shes par 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis bram ze rnams la yang ngan sems bskyed par mi bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / rgyal po rab snang srog stor ba las phyir rnyed pa bzhin du dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / rangs pa dang / bde ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen pos bshad pa la rjes su yi rangs yinas rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te stan las langs te song ngo / /de rang gi khyim du song nas tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen pos ji skad smras pa de thams cad bsgrubs te gdung ma yang gzhan zhig bcug /rta rdzi 11—34

gnyer ①len yang ②de ltar byed du ma bcug③ /rdzing bu yang chus bkang /glang po che dang / ri dgas dang / ngang pa rnams kyang btang ngo / /zhag bdun na de'i skyes ji skad bstan pa thams cad kyang phyin nas de nor rnyed pas yid ④bde ba skyes nas/ tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po la je sems mngon par dad par gyur te bsams pa/ bdag gi khyim na dpal dang dbang thang phun sum tshogs pa gang cung zad yod pa de thams cad ni 'phags pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po la brten nas byung ba ⑤yin no/ /de'i phyir re zhig gos be'u ras yug po che 'di bskur la phyis rgyal srid bstabs ༅par bya'o snyam du rig nas mi zhig la smras pa/ kye skyes bu khyod tshur gos be'u ras yug po che 'di khyer rtsal 'phags pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po la phul cig ces byas pa dang / des gos be'u ras yug po che de khyer nas 'phags pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po la byin no/ /de nas ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba dang / skya bseng gi bu mo sgrol ma dang / gzhon nu ba lang skyong dang / gsos pa dang / mdun na 'don la smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga shel yul sna tshogs la dbang ba'i rgyal po rnams kyis skyes 'di dag bskur gyis spukhyed gang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin khyer cig /de nas ba lang skyong gi ma zhi bas ni gser gyi phreng nyu) ba khyer/ skya bseng gi bu mo sgrol mas ni la ba rin po che/gzhon nu ba lang skyong gis ni rta gnyis/ gsos pas ni ral gri zung cig /mdun na 'don gyis ni nor bu'i lham zung cig khyer te glang po che'i gtso bo lus pa de rgyal pos khyer ro/ /de nas rgyal po rab snang yan lag gi mchog lnga la rin po che dag gi ⑩bgo bsha' byas nas tsotshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po ga la ba der song ste phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po'i rkang pa la mgo bos 11—35

phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig ①tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig ②tu 'dug nas rgyal po rab snang gis tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa sman 'dogs shing gces duspras mdzad pa lags te/ de'i slad du bdag 'phags pa la rgyal srid stobs na thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ④ste rgyal srid bzhes su gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen pos smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong la rgyal srid byed pa bkag go/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te de ltar zhun 'dod pa thams cad stobs na/'dod pa thams cad yongs su spyad du gsol/ des smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis ༅'dod pa thams cad kyang bkag go/ /rgyal pos smras pa/'phags pa gal te de lta na longs spyod dang / longs spyod kyi mchog rnams stobs rtson yongs su spyad du gsol/ des smras pa/ rgyal po chen po re zhig bcom ldan 'das la zhus te bya'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'phags pa de ltar mdzod cig de'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das ni mnyan yod na rgyal bu durgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /skabs de lta bu la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mi mkhyen pa dang spu/ mi gzigs pa dang rtso) / mi rig pa dang n+tu ci/ rnam par mi rig pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' ste/bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ dge slong ka t+ya'i bu chen po longs spyod dang longs spyod kyi mchog rnams don du gnyer ba ma yin mod kyi 'on kyang skye skyebo phyi ma rnams la phan gdags 8so snyam du dgongs nas 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa de'i tshe/ srog chags grog spur ④11—36

rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs sems kyis shes so/ /gang gi tshe 'jig rten las 'das pa'i thugs bskyed pa de'i tshe ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs sems kyis mi shes na/byol song gi skye gnas su song ba rnams kyis ༅lta smos kyang ci dgos/ don 'di la ni bcom ldan 'das dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po'i thugs dang sems su 'phrod pa'i 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen pos lha'i mig dang lha'i rna ba mngon par bsgrubs nas phan tshun lta ༄ba dang nyan par yang zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa dge slong gis dudage 'dun gyi ched du longs spyod dang gelongs spyod kyi mchog dag blang du rung lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ka t+ya'i bu chen po skye bo phyi ma rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir dang / sbyin pa po rnams kyi longs spyod 'phel bar byed pa'i 42phyir rung ste/ de lta bas na dge 'dun la longs spyod dang longs spyod kyi mchog rnams gnang gi gang zag la ni ma yin thono/ /de la longs spyod ni 2'di dag yin te/ grong dang / zhing rnams so/ /longs spyod kyi mchog ni ba lang dang / ma he dang /ra dang / lug rnams so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das la zhus nas rgyal po rab snang la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo phyi ma rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir dang /sbyin bdag rnams kyi longs spyod 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir dge 'dun la longs spyod dang longs spyod kyi mchog rnams gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal po rab snang gis ⑧11—37

tshe dang ldan pa ka t+ya'i bu chen po las brten nas yo byad thams cad ①phun sum tshogs pa'i gtsug lag khang byed du bcug ste/ phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul nas longs spyod dang longs spyod kyi ②mchog rnams kyang phul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i dge bsnyen nga'i nyan thos dge 'dun la thog mar 'dod pa thams cad stobs pa rnams kyi nang na mchog ni 'di lta ste/ 'phags rgyal gyi rgyal po rab snang 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag nga'i dge bsnyen nga'i nyan thos dge 'dun la thog mar bshos 'bul ba rnams kyi nang na mchog ni 'di lta ste/ rgyal po'i khab kyi rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag nga'i dge bsnyen nga'i nyan thos dge 'dun la thog mar gnas mal 'bul ba rnams kyi nang na mchog ni 'di lta ste/ mnyan yod kyi khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di yin no/ /dge slong dag nga'i dge bsnyen nga'i nyan thos dge 'dun la thog mar gtsug lag khang byed pa rnams kyi nang na mchog ni 'di lta ste/ yul bā rā ṇa sī'i rkyokhyim bdag bzang ldan 'di yin no// //bar sdom ni/ 'dod pa kun gyi curab snang ste/ /dge 'dun bshos kyi phye bzo sbyangs yin/ /gnas mal mgon med zas sbyin te/ /gtsug lag khang gi ⑥ bzang ldan no/ /rgyal po rab snang btsun mo'i 'khor du res kyis zan za ste/nyi ma gcig ⑦ni ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba'i drung du/ gcig ni skya bseng zhugi bu mo sgrol ma'i drung du'o/ /de 0dus gzhan zhig na dgongs payi/ ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba'i thad du zan za ba na rgyal po de zho la dga' bas ba lang skyong gi ma ⑪zho'i phor ba thogs te de zan za ba'i mdun na 'dug go/ /ji tsam na phyogs 11—38

der skya bseng ①gi bu mo sgrol ma song ste/ des la ba rin po che bgos pa dang /des glog byung ba lta bur rgyal po de ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba dang bcas te snang bar byas so/ /zhi bas snang ba de mthong nas ya mtshan skyes te smras pa/ lha 'di ci lags / glog ②cig glo ③bur du byung ngam/ 'ga' zhig gis zhugs mar ①'tshal / des smras pa/ zhi ba 'di ni glog gi 'od kyang ma yin/ mar me'i ⑤yang ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang skya ⑥bseng gi bu mo sgrol ma phyogs 'di nas song ste/des la ba rin po che bgos pas 'di ni de'i 'od yin no/ /khyod kyis la ba rin po che de lta bu btang ste gser gyi phreng ⑦ba blangs pa ni khyod blun no/ /ji bdag gi khyim na gser gyi ⑤phreng ba med dam/ nyis na rigs ngan pa las skyes pa de the gi'o / /des smras pa/ lha de la de lta bu'i shes rab ga la mchis/ gdon ma 'tshal bar khyod nyid kyis la ba rin po che long shig ces bstan te des na des blangs lags mod/ rgyal pos smras pa/ ngas de la ma smras te des rang gi blos blangs so/ /khyod kyis smras so/ /ngas ma smras so zhes de gnyis 'thabs ⑨par gyur nas/ zhi bas de'i mgor zho'i phor bas bsnun pa dang / rgyal po de spyi gcer ⑩zhig pas de'i klad (trepa zhom mo/ /des lag pas mnams tho)te bsams pa/bdag gi klad 8pa yang ④zhim/ bdag gi klad 8rgyas kyang lug pas 'dis ye bdag bsad kyis ⑩ji srid srog dang ma bral gyi bar du je 'di bsad ⑩do snyam nas / des gsos pa la bsgo ba/ gsos pa ngas ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba ⑫yongs su btang gis yisod cig /gsos pas bsams pa/ de 'di la shin tu 'phangs 0na 'di khros pa'i ⑥kun nas dkris 0pas 'di skad du zer bar zad pas 'phral dul gsad ④par mi bya'i kun nas dkris pa dang bral nas bsam ⑥pa 11—39

shes par bya ste gsad kyis ①re zhig gnas dben pa zhig tu gzhag ②go snyam du rig nas/ smras pa/ lha de ltar 'tshal te dgum dumo zhes byas nas/ des de gnas dben pa zhig tu bzhag go/ /rgyal pos lakun nas dkris ⑤ pa dang bral nas smras pa/ gsos pa ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba ga re/ des smras pa/lha khyod kyis ngas ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba yongs su btang gis sod ༅cig ces bka' stsal pas bdag gis de lha'i bka' bzhin du bkum lags so/ /des smras pa/ gsos pa legs so/ /da ni nga dang / skya bseng ⑦gi bu mo sgrol ma dang / gzhon nu ba lang skyong dang / mdun na 'don kyang song la khyod nyid cod pan chings te rgyal srid byed la rag go/ /ngas ko des dung la ma gus pa byas pas ngas de nan thur nyubyas la phyis dga' bar bya'o snyam du bsam bsam ⑩na khyod kyis mod kho na la bsad pa lta zhig /des smras pa/ lha 'di na skyes bu mkhas pa kha cig smras pa'i don dpes kyang kun 'tshal bar 'gyur bas re zhig dpe gsan du gsol/bsdus pa'i sdom ni/ khra bo dang ni sgren mo dang / /rnyed par dka' dang slu nyunyeb dang / /mi ngoms pa dang gnyid 8gtogs par/ /bsdus 6pa'i sdom du yang dag bsdus/ /sdom ni/ khra bo spre'u dang 'jig rten na/ /long ba dag ste tha ma yin/ /rgyal po chen po sngon byung cob ri'i phyogs mi 'du ba dang 'jigs pa ma mchis pa shing sna tshogs kyi tshal gyis brgyan pa/ seng ge dang /stag dang / dred dang / byi la dang / ri dgas dang / phag rgod rgyu ba/bya'i tshogs sna tshogs kyis bsten pa gcig cig tu srog chags thi bas shing chen po zhig gi khar tshang bcas te/ des de 'bras bu smin 8pa rnams kyis bkang nas 11—40

chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo khyod kyis 'bras bu 'di dag bza' bar mi bya ste/da lta ni gang yang rung bas bdag nyid 'tsho bar bya'o/ /nam rlung dang /yul ngan byung ba de'i tshe 'di dag bza' bar bya'o/ /des smras pa/ legs te de bzhin bya'o/ /ji tsam na rlung dang nyi mas phog pas 'bras bu rnams skams nyute tshang de 'gribs par gyur pa dang / thi bas smras pa/ bzang mo ngas khyod la khyod kyis du 'bras bu 'di dag bza' bar mi bya ste/ rlung ngam yul ngan byung ba'i tshe bza' bar bya'o zhes ma rgyabakag gam/ 'o na ci'i phyir khyod kyis zos/ des smras pa/ bdag gis ma zos so/ /des smras pa/ ngas tshang co'adi bkang ste bzhag na/ gal te khyod kyis ma zos na 'o na tshang 'di ci'i phyir 'gribs par gyur / des smras pa/ tshang 'di ci'i phyir 'gribs ma shes/ bdag gis ni 'di las 'bras bu cig gekyang ma zos so/ /khyod kyis zos so ngas ma zos so zhes shide gnyis lan dang yang lan 'debs pa na thab tsomo byung ste des thi ba mo de mchus bsnun nas srog dang bral te de de nyid na 'phyang 3zhing 'dug go/ /re zhig cig na dus ma yin pa'i char chen po bab pa dang / yang tshang de de kho na bzhin du 'bras bu de dag gis gang nas des bsams pa/ tshang 'di 'bras bu dag gis yang gang ba las na des 'di dag ma zos so snyam nas/ des de la bzod pa gsol bar brtsams pa/ khra mo 6sdug pa longs shig /'di dag khyod kyis ma zos te bdag gi tshang 'di gang gis nyes pa cig bzod par mdzod cig ces byas pa dang / lhas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ nags byatshal rgyu ba'i thi ba ni/ /'dab 7ma khra bo mig dmar ba/ /rang gis ④sdug ma 8bsad nas ni//blo ngan ci zhig mya ngan byed/ /ji ltar thi ba bab col tshuspyod pa yis/ /'di na 11—41

sdug pa nyes med bsad nas ni/ /blo rmongs mya ngan byed cing bzang mo zhes/ /de ①la bzhams te nyes cig ②bzod gsol ba/ /de bzhin rgyal po gzu lums spyod pa yis/ /zhi ba yid dang 'thad pa 'dir bsad nas/ /blo rmongs mya ngan byed cing bzang mo zhes/ /de dul bzhams te nyes cig ④bzod pa gsol/ /zhes bgyi ba lags te/ lha khyod kyis gsungs pa'i don ni bdag dpe de dang 'dra ba snyam bgyid do/ /lha gzhan yang khyim bdag cig dbyar 'das pa dang ston gyi dus su sran ma'i khur 'tshal nas zhing thog tu chas phyeso/ /des sran ma'i khur de shing drung zhig tu bzhag nas pha zad ༅du bshang ba'i sar mchis pa dang / ji tsam na spre'u zhig shing de las babs nas sran ma las spar gang blangs te yang shing de las ④'dzegs so/ /de 'dzeg ⑧pa na sran ma 'brum bu gcig zloshor de byas la lhung nas des sran ma spar gang po de bor te/ sran ma 'brum bu cig hu po de btsal bar brtsams pa na/ khyim bdag des de la bong ba kyecig bsnun te de dus las 'das pa dang lhas tshigs su 6bcad de smras pa/ sran ma spar gang bor nas su/ /gang zhig 'bras 6bu gcig tshol bsku/ /shin tu tshogs mang ldan pa yi/ /spre'u 'di kye ma re mi mdzangasabya/ /zhes bgyi ba lags te lhas gsungs pa'i don gang zhig ba lang skyong gi ma bkum nas/ yang bzod pa gsol bar bzhed pa ni cibadag dpe de dang 'dra ba snyam bgyid do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa khyod kyis tshig cig kho na'i kha la ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad do/ /des smras pa/ lha/ ston pa gang zag zla med pa/ /gcig pu tshig 8ni gcig gsung ste/ /gsung ba de ni nges lags 0pas/ /'di la bdag blo 'gyur ma mchis/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan du tam/ rgyal pos 11—42

smras pa/ gsos pa khyod kyis gang gi phyir ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas nga long bar byas so/ /des smras pa/ lha①/ lha dang mir bcas 'jig rten 'dir/ /long ba gnyis ni nges grub pa/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dmus long dang / /gang yang chos la mi gnas pa'o/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /gzhan yang long ba gnyis lags te/ /gang la sdig lta de yod dmadu/ /gang zhig khrims la mi brten ③pa'o/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/sdom ni/ sgren mo cir yang mi rung dang / /ma spyad gtun dang lan gcig dang / /nad dang bag tsha brnyas pa dang / /de bzhin du ni bags kyis ④so / /byis pa dang ni bshes dag dang / /skyes bu tha shal nyid dang ni/ /shing rta yis ④ni 'khor lo dang / /g.yo gtogs ⑥par ni yongs su rdzogs/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi ⑦phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas nga sgren mor byas so/ /des smras pa/ lha sgren mo gsum gyi dumi mdzes pa khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gsum gang yin/lha / klung ni chu med sgren mo ste/ /yul 'khor 'gron rdzumed sgren mo'o/ /gal te ming po bcu yod kyang / /khyo med bud med sgren mo'o/ /zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas nga cir yang ⑩mi rung bar byas so/ /des smras pa/ lha 'jig rten na yicir yang 8mi rung ba gsum mchis par khyod kyis ma gsan tam/des smras pa/ gsos pa gsum gang yin/ lha/ rta bo thal kur bang bul dang //ston mo bya na med pa dang / /bud med gang zhig khyim sun 'byin/ /'di gsum cir yang mi rung ba'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa ba lang skyong gi 11—43

ma zhi ba longs ma spyad par khyod kyis bsad do/ /des smras pa/ lha/ sol ba byed pa'i gos dang ni/ /bkru bshal byed pa'i lham dag dang / /rgyal po'i btsun mo'i 'khor nyurnams ni/ /longs ma spyad par dudengs par 'gyur/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ lha de dag 'ba' zhig tu ma bas gzhan yang gsum ste/ nags kyi shing gi me tog dang / /dka' thub can gyi lang tsho dang //shing rta mkhan gyi chung ma dag /longs ma spyad par dengs par 'gyur/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni gtun gyis brdeg pa'i rgyu'o/ /des smras pa/ lha/ shing mkhan rtsang rtsing 'jog pa dang / /bzang semakhan skud pa ring po dang / /kha lo sgyur ba mig rgyang thung / /de gsum gtun gyis brdeg rgyu'o/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ lha de dag 'ba' zhig tu ma bas/ gzhan yang gsum ste/pho nya'i pho nya gang yin dang / /mngag gzhug pa yi samangag gzhug dang / /bud med 'phyon ma byed pa gang / /de gsum bkun sagyis brdeg rgyu'o/ /lha de dag 'ba' zhig tu ma bas gzhan yang gsum ste/ gnag rdzi grong na rgyu ba dang / /'breg khumakhan nags na rgyu ba dang / /mag tshupa rtag tu 'ong byed pa/ /de gsum gtun gyis brdeg rgyu'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba lan gcig gis bsad do/ /des smras pa/ lha/ rgyal po smra ba lan gcig ste/ /bu mo sbyin pa lan gcig go/ /'phags pa'i gzigs pa lan gcig ste/ /de gsum lan re lan re 'o/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad ⑧pas khyod ni rang gis nad bslangs 0so/ /des smras pa/11—44

lha / snar ma sna tshogs go gyon dang / / rtswa mjing 2chung ngu nor mang dang / /rgan dupo chung ma gzhon len pa/ /de dag rang gis nad bslangs ༅so/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas nga ni khyod la bag tsha'o/ /des smras pa/lha / dka' 'thub can ni blun mthong dang / /dpa' bo rma mtshan med pa dang //bu mo chen mo mthong nas ni/ /snying la bag tsha skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes bgyi rgyab khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas nga brnyas so/ /des smras pa/ lha/ cal le col le smra ba skyodang / /gnyis pa gos ngan gyon pa dang / /skru thozhing za ba gang yin pa/ /de gsum brnyas dupar bya ba yin/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas ngas khyod dgra zhig rtsibags kyis spel to/ /des smras pa/ lha/ nya ni bags kyis bza' bar byate/ /ri bo la ni bags kyis gzeganyunye don rnams bags kyis bsgrub bya ste/ /'di gsum bags kyis bags kyis 8bya/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni byis pa'o/ /des smras pa / lha/ ma 'dris pa la yid rton kyedang / /ma rungs pa la sten ④pa dang / /gya tsom bdu ni yongs gtong ba/ /byis pa'i mtshan nyid rnam gsum mo/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan ⑩tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni bshes pa 'byed pa yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/ bshes rnams la ni mi sten ⑩dang / /gnyis pa ha cang 11—45

sten ①pa dang / /dus ma yin par slong ②byed pa/ /des ni bshes rnams 'byed par byed/ /ces bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni skyes bu tha shal yin no / /des smras pa/ lha/ rtag tu gzhan gyi nor dang ni/ /bdag nyid 'dod pa rnog byed dang / /de bzhin sdug bsngal la dga' ba/ /de gsum skyes bu tha cushal yin/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan dutam/rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis thob lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni shing rta'i 'khor los gsad rgyu yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/ri mo mkhan ni tshon gtong mi shes dang / /'khrul 'khor mkhan ni 'byor ka mi shes dang / /gyad gyi bu ni dor thabs mi shes pa/ /gsad rtsobya gsad par rtag tu bzlog pa med/ /ces bgyi ba lhas ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong zhugi ma zhi ba bsad /pas khyod ni g.yo skye can yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/ bud med khyo gsum brgyud pa dang / /dge slong phyir ni 'ongs pa dang / bya ni nyunyergya las shor dang gsum/ /g.yo ri nyecan nang na de g.yo ngan/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/sdom ni/ rnyed par dka' dang gzhan dang gcig /bsags dang de bzhin mi mthun dang / /brdungs cadang med pa nyid dang ni/ /mi 'tsham pa ni codon med do/ /gsos pa khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma rnyed dka' ba bsad do//des smras pa/ lha/ ri bong rwa can rnyed par dka'/ /ru sbal spu can rnyed par dka' / /smad 'tshong gcig pu 'dug pa dang / /gzu tsobo drang por smra rnyed dka' / /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos 11—46

pa khyod kyis gzhan gyi ched du ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad do/ /des smras pa/lha / gtams ①pa len dang gnya' bo rgyadang / /g.yon can gyi ni che ②bzhi dang ④/ /smyan ⑤byed blo zhan bzhi po dag⑥ /gzhan gyi don du ma rung ⑦'gyur//zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis dum gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi ⑨phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas nga gcig pur ⑨ byas so/ /des smras pa/ lha/ skye ba na yang 'di gcig skye bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'chi ba na yang 'di gcig 'chi/ /skye bo yigacig pus 8'di na sdug bsngal myong / /'khor ba la ni grogs yod ma yin no/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba tshogs bsags pa bsad do/ /des smras pa/ lha/ nya sgong a tsamra'i me tog dang / /sdug bsngal gyur pa'i don gnyer ba/ /dper na ston ku'i sprin bzhin du/ /bsags pa rnams kyang don med 'gyur/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad 6pas khyod ni mi mthun pa yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/ nyi ma grib mar mi mthun zhing / /snang ba dang ni mun pa dang / /nyin par mtshan mor mi mthun te/ /chos dang chos min rtag mi mthun ⑫/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad tshupas khyod ni brdung rgyu'o/ /des smras pa/ lha/ gos rnams brdungs na 'jam po dag tu 'gyur/ /bong bu brdungs na de dag mgyogs par 'gyur / /bud med rnams ni brdungs na dbang du 'gyur/ /rnga ⑩dag ma brdungs sgra 'byin mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal 11—47

pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni med par bya ba yin no②/ /des smras pa/ lha/ rlung gis sbun pa ②med par byed/ /skye bo'i sgra yis glu de bzhin/ /skyes bu ngan pa bsten pa dang / /mi mdzes yon tan med par byed/ /ces bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam / rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni 'tsham pa ma yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/ rgyal po brdzun du smra ba chadang / /sman pa gsung dang dge sbyong 'khrug /blo dang ldan pa kun rmongs ④pa/ /bzhi ni 'tsham pa ma yin no/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa khyod kyis don med par ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad do/ /des smras pa/ lha/ nyin par mar me bus pa don med do/ /rgya mtshor char pa bab pa don med do/ /'grangs ⑤la ston mo byin pa don med do/ /skyes bu ngan pa bsten pa don med do/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/sdom ni/ slu dang ⑥blta dang ma legs dang / /bskrad dang 'jigs dang mi dga' gtang ⑦/ /sred dang ma bsams mya ngan gtogs/ /de ni tshogs ⑧su yang dag bsgrags/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni slu ⑨ba yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/slu ⑩ba bzhi mchis par khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ bzhi gang yin/ lha/ mi 'dod pa la 'doms pa dang / /gnyid kyis dub la 'chad pa dang / /don du gnyer min don gnyer dang / /stobs dang ldan rnams 'gyed pa'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad 11—48

pas khyod ni blta bar bya ba yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/ g.yul ngor dpa' bo blta bya ste/ /mi bzad dug la gsang sngags blta/ /bza' btung tshe na nye ①du ste 0/ /don rtogs bya la mkhas pa blta/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ②ma gsan tam / /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ④ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas ma legs pa byas so/ /des smras pa/ lha/ khyim pa le lo ma legs chags ma legs/ /rab byung yang dag sdom pa min ma legs/ /rgyal po gzu lums spyod pa'ang ma legs te/ /mkhas gang ⑤'khrug byed de yang ma legs so/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis yib lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni bskrad par bya ba yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/ mi mkhas shing rta gcog ⑦pa dang / /khal chen 'gel bas glang gsod dudang / /ha cang bzhos pas be'u gsod dang / /nye du'i khyim 'dug 0chung ma bskrad/ /ces bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod mthong na nga 'jigs so/ /des smras pa/ lha/ 'ur pa dang ni chu skyar dang / /gsum pa phyag dar srin bu dang / /bzhi pa lham bu chu gsher ni//'jigs bya min la 'jigs par byed/ /ces bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba med pas mi dga'o/ /des smras pa/ lha/ spre'u ni grong na mi dga' ste/ /chu srin byis pa gsod ri la / /chom rkun dge sbyong khyim du ste7/ /byi po yirang gi khyim mi dga'/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni gtang bar 8bya ba yin no/ /11wa 49

des smras pa/ lha/ rigs kyi phyir ni gcig gtang ①ste/ /grong gi phyir ni rigs gtang ②ngo / /yul gyi phyir ni grong gtang ste / /bdag gi phyir ni yul gtang ngo / /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas nga'i sred pa 'chad du mi ④btub po/ /des smras pa/ lha①/ rtsa med gzhan ⑥gyi bud med dang / /lag pa gcig gis chu 'thung dang / /gzhan gyis chang blud gang yin pa / /de dag sred pa 'chad ⑦pa med/ /ces bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa khyod kyis ma bsams pa kho nar ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad nido/ /des smras pa/ lha/ rgyal po 0rgyal po'i mdzod ni ma bsams par/ /lam du zhugs la chom por ⑩ma bsams par/ /khyim na bud med thab yimo ma bsams par/ /rab tu byung ba'i rnyed pa ma bsams par/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas mya ngan bya ba yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/ chags can rgas pa'ang mya ngan bya ba ste/ /mi bzang por mo'ang ⑫mya ngan bya ba yin/ /smad 'tshong rgas pa'ang mya ngan bya ba ste/ /rab byung gtum po'ang mya ngan bya ba yin/ ci /sdom ni/ blta bas mi ngoms yid 'thad dang ⑫/ /brtse ④bar mi bya nor dang ni/ /smra bar mi bya rab sdang dang / /mgon med bshes tsodang yid brtan pa'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa khyod kyis nga'i ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba blta bas mi ngoms pa bsad do/ /des smras pa/ lha/ glang po'i gtso dang rgyal po dang / /rgya ⑩mtsho dang ni ri rab dang / /sangs rgyas smra ba rnams 11—50

kyi mchog /blta ba yis ni mi ngoms yin/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba nga'i yid dang 'thad pa bsad do/ /des smras pa/ lha/ gzugs bzang mo dang rigs ldan dang / /des dang rigs ni 'phel byed pa①/ /dar la bab dang bud med lnga②//rgyal chen yid dang 'thad pa yin/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod dang lhan cig rtse bar mi bya ba yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/ byis pa sbrul dang sbal ba dang / /gang gi ma ni g.yem pa dang / /mi gang mdza' ni mi rtag dang / /lhan cig rtse bar mi bya'o/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod kyis nor 'phrog pa byas so/ /des smras pa/ lha/ rol mo mkhan dang dmag mi dang / /sman pa chom rkun btson snurdzi ste/ /de dag nyam thag gyur pa la'ang / /nor ni 'phrog par byed pa yin/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni smra bar bya ba ma yin no/ /des smras pa/lha / ha cang phyug dang ha cang dbul/ /dma' dang ha cang mtho gang dang / /ha cang ring dang ha cang nye/ /de drug smra bar bya ba min④/ /zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis ma gsan tam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gsos pa gang gi phyir khyod kyis ba lang skyong gi ma zhi ba bsad pas khyod ni sems rab tu sdang ba yin no/ /des smras pa/ lha/ sbyin pa mi snang mi mthun byed pa dang / /mthun ⑤par mi byed nyes spyod sgrogs pa dang / /sbyin pa byin nas rim gyis ldog byed pa/ /de dag rab 11—61
