bzhi rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa can rnams kyis ①ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rjes su dran par 'gyur bar bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni 'khrungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ②'dir ni lan gsum du bzlas te chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni phung po lhag ma ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las cha'adas pa ste/ dge slong dag nga ④'das pa'i 'og tu 'dir mchod rten skor ⑤ba dang / mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba 'ong gis ⑥de dag la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni 'khrungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir ⑦ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dir ni lan gsum du bzlas te chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni phung po lhag ma med pa'i lamya ngan las ⑨'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /zhes bya ba'i bar dag yin te/ kha cig nga la sems ⑩dad pas dus byas pa de thams cad mtho ris su 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni phung po'i ⑩lhag ma dang bcas par ro/ /dge slong dag sa phyogs 'di bzhi rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa can rnams kyis ji srid 'tsho'i tsobar du 'gro bar 'gyur bar bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni 'khrungs tsoso/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so//bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dir ni lan gsum du tshubazlas te chos kyi 'khor lo rnam 11—698

pa bcu gnyis su bskor to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni phung po lhag ma med ①pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa ste/dge slong dag nga 'das pa'i 'og tu mchod rten bskor ba dang / mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba ②'ongs pa rnams la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni 'khrungs ②so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par ④sangs rgyas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dir ni lan gsum du ⑤bzlas te chos ⑥kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni phung po lhag ma ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i ⑦dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so zhes bya ba'i bar dag yin te/ kha cig ni nga la sems dad pas dus byas pa ⑧de thams cad mtho ris su 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni phung po'i 0lhag ma dang bcas par ro/ /ji ltar mngon rngudu 'gro bar bya ba de ltar rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong dag sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang / sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba ༅dang / 'gog pa dang / lam rnams la gang som nyi dang yid gnyis yod pa ma dgag par zhus shig dang dris pa de tsongs lung bstan par bya'o/ /khyed kyis 'di ji ltar bdag cag gis 8ston pa'i spyan sngar mngon sum tsodu lan gdab par ni mi spobs so snyam du blta bar mi tsobya ste/ dge slong dag gis dge slong dag la/ rogs dag gis rogs dag la smra bar bya zhing dris na de lung bstan par bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'di ltar btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis 11—699

gsungs ①pa'i don bdag gis 'tshal ba ltar na/ dge slong gi 'khor ji snyed 'dus shing mchis ②pa 'di rnams las gang dge slong dag chagacig la yang sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang / sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam rnams la gang som nyi ④dang yid gnyis su gyur pa ma mchis lags so/ /kun dga' bo legs so ②legs so/ /kun dga' bo khyod ni dad pas 'di skad smra yimod kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs ⑦pa ni bla na med par 'jug pa yin te/ dge slong gi 'khor ji snyed 'dus shing 'khod pa rnams la ni gang dge slong gcig la yang 0sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam rnams la som nyi dang yid gnyis med mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'di'i dgos pa ni dus phyi ma'i sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thugs brtse ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rang gi sku las stod g.yogs bsal te/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ ⑨dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ltos ④shig /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la rnam par ltos sh+yi shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 8yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas blta ba ni rnyed par dka' ste/ dper na me tog u dum bā cir bzhin no/ /dge slong dag re zhig cang ma smra zhig dang / 'di ltar 'dus byas thams cad ni 'jig pa'i chos can yin te/ de la 'di ni 8de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung tha ma'o zhes gsungs tsonas bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bsam gtan dang po las bzhengs nas bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa las bzhengs nas bsam gtan 11—700

gsum pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bsam gtan ①gsum pa las bzhengs nas bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa las bzhengs nas nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par zhugs so/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las bzhengs nas rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par zhugs duso/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las bzhengs nas ci yang med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par zhugs so/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched las bzhengs nas 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la snyoms par zhugs so/ /'du shes ②med 'du shes med min skye mched las bzhengs nas 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa la 'di skad ces smas ④so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das sam/tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ma yin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags ⑤pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par zhugs te/zhi ba mi g.yo ba'i spyan dang ldan pa brnyes yinas yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o zhes bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la ⑦mngon sum du thos shing mngon sum dudu bzung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog ⑨pa las bzhengs te / 'du shes med ⑩'du shes med min skye mched la snyoms par zhugs so/ /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched las bzhengs nas ci yang med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par zhugs so/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched las bzhengs nas rnam ⑩shes mtha' yas skye tsomached la snyoms par zhugs so/ /rnam shes mtha' 11—701

yas skye mched las bzhengs nas nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par zhugs so/ /nam mkha' mtha' ①yas skye mched las bzhengs nas bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa las ③bzhengs nas bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bsam gtan gsum pa las bzhengs nas ②bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa las bzhengs nas bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bsam gtan dang po las bzhengs nas bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ / klubasam gtan gnyis pa las bzhengs nas bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bsam gtan gsum pa las bzhengs nas bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par zhugs ④te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par zhugs nas zhi ba mi g.yo ba'i spyan dang ldan pa brnyes te yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das ma thag tu sa chen po yang g.yos par gyur/ skar mda' yang lhung / phyogs kyang tshig /bar snang las lha dag gis rnga'i sgra yang bsgrags so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na 'dug pa de sa g.yos pas sad de⑥/ 'di ci zhig ces bsams na/ bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das par mthong ngo / /des 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad ni de dang ⑦'dra'o zhes chos nyid la brten nas des bsams pa/ 'di ltar lus 'phags ma'i bu rgyal po ma skyes dgra rtsa ba med pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa des bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de thos par gyur na khrag dron por skyugs nas 'chi ba'i dus 11—702

byed pa'i gnas su 'gyur bar rig nas de la thabs zhig bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsams ①nas/ yul ma ga d+ma'i tsosna chen po la gtogs pa bram ze dbyar byed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dbyar byed shes par gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur te/ gal te lus 'phags ma'i bu rgyal po ma skyes dgra rtsa ba med pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa des bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa thos na de khrag dron po skyugs nas 'chi ba'i dus byed par gyur lan/ de la khyod kyis thabs bsgrub par rig par gyis shig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa thabs gang lags pa rim ④bzhin du gsungs ༅shig /des smras pa/ dbyar byed tshur shog /khyod myur ba myur bar rgyal po'i skyed ⑥mos tshal du song la/ ji ltar bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi rtseganas na bzhugs ⑧shing gzigs pa lngas gzigs te 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lalha drug la lan gsum du sbyang ba tsomadzad nas glang po cher ⑩bstan te yum gyi lhums su gshegs pa dang / gshegs nas ji ltar byang chub 8kyi shing drung du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / ji ltar bcom ldan 'das yul bā rā ṇa sīr tsolan gsum du bzlas te chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor ba dang / ji ltar mnyan yod du cho 'phrul chen po bstan ④pa dang / ji ltar sum bcu rtsa gsum lha'i gnas 8su skrun pa'i yum gyi thad du gshegs nas chos bshad de grong khyer sgra can du bab pa dang / ji ltar phyogs gang dang gang na gdul ba de dang de dag btul nas/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin te/ grong khyer rtswa ②can du tha ma'i gzims mal du gshegs pa de ⑩lta bu'i ri mo dag bri tsobar bya zhing / khyod 11—703

kyis gzhong rings bdun ni ①mar gyi mar sar gyis/ brgyad pa ni tsan dan go shir gas ②bkang ste skyed ②mos tshal gyi phyogs der gzhag go/ /ji ④tsam ①rgyal po sgor byung bar gyur pa dang / de la lha re zhig skyed ༅mos tshal gzigs su gshegs ⑦zhes smras nas/ gal ②te ri mo mthong nas dbyar byed 'di ci yin zhes 'dri ba dang / rgya cher bshad par bya ste/ lha 'di ni grong khyer ser skya can lags te/ phyogs 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das 'khrungs so/ /'di ni chu bo nai rañdza yina'i 'gram lags te/ phyogs 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /'di ni yul bā rā na sī'i ⑩grong khyer lags te/phyogs 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gsum du bzlas te chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor to/ /'di ni mnyan 7yod kyi grong khyer lags te/phyogs 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das kyis cho 'phrul chen po bstan to ⑫/ /'di ni grong khyer sgra can lags te/ 'dir tsani bcom ldan 'das sum bcu rtsa gsum ④lha rnams kyi gnas nas babs so/ /'di ni grong khyer rtswa tho)can thozilags te/phyogs 'dir ni phyogs gang dang gang na 'dul ba de dang de dag btul nas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin te/ tha ma'i gzims mal du gshegs ⑦so zhes gyis dang / thos nas thos ma thag tu lha brgyal 8te sa la lhung ⑩bar 'gyur gyis tshul/ de la khyod kyis gzhong rings mar sar gyis bkang ba'i nang du gzhug ⑥par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe mar sar de zhu bar gyur pa dang / de gnyis pa nas/bdun pa'i bar du gzhug 6par bya'o/ /de nas phyung nas 0tsan dan go shir gas ④bkang ba'i gzhong ⑤rings su chug shig dang / de sos par 'gyur ro zhes 11—704

smras nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po grong khyer rtswa ①can du song ngo / /dbyar byed kyang myur ba myur bar ②ri mo'i las snothams cad rgya cher bris te/bris nas rgyal po ④phyi rol du byung ba dang / lha skyed ⑤mos tshal du gshegs zhes smras te/ de skyed ༅mos tshal du zhugs pa dang / ri mo dag mthong nas dbyar byed 'di ci yin zhes dris te/ des 'di ni gong ༅khyer rtswa ⑧can lags te/phyogs 'dir 0ni bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑪ tha ma'i gzims mal du gshegs so zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin du rgyas par bshad do/ /des smras pa/ dbyar byed ci zer ci bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das sam zhes smras pa dang / de cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgra brgyal te sa la lhung ba dang / dbyar byed kyis gzhong rings mar sar yigyis bkang ba'i nang du lan bdun gyi bar du bcug nas/ de nas phyung ste/ tsan dan go shir gas chubakang ba'i gzhong rings kyi nang du bcug pa dang de sos par gyur to8//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das ma thag tu shing sā ④la zung gnyis kyi tshal sā ④la'i ljon shing mchog las me tog 'thor ba'i drung du bcom ldan 'das seng ge lta bur yigazims pa dang / de'i tshe dge slong gzhan zhig gis tshigs su bcad de smras pañtsa/ sā tsol zung ni rab mdzes pa'i/ /ljon shing mchog gi tshal bu yi'adir/ /ston pa mya ngan 'das pa la/ /me tog dag gis rab tu gtor/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das ma thag tu lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ kye ma 'du byed mi rtag ste/ /skye zhing 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ /skyes nas 'jig par 'gyur ba ste / /de dag nye bar zhi ba bde/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las tshu11—705

'das ma thag tu mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/'byung po kun gyis 'jig rten 'dir ni bsags pa'i mtha'/ /'dod ①'gyur 'jig rten 'di na ②gang zag zla med cing / /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs rnams brnyes pa spyan ldan pa/ /ston pa 'di lta bu yang yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs ②su mya ngan las ④'das ma thag tu tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ brtan pa'i thugs kyis skyob ⑤mdzad cing / /mi g.yo zhi ba brnyes ⑨gyur pa/ /dbugs dbyung ⑦ba dang rngub 'gags nas/ /spyan ldan yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog ②ldan pa/ /gang tshe ston pa dus mdzad de/ /de tshe rab tu sngangs gyur cing / /de tshe spu yang langs par gyur/ /zhum pa med pa'i thugs kyis ni//tshor ba dag la 0lhag par gnas/ /de yi thugs ni rnam grol ⑩ba/ /sgron ma de 'dra mya ngan 'das/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das ma thag tu dge slong kha cig ni sa la 'gre ldog /kha cig ni dpungs la bzung nas ku cho ༅'don/ kha cig ni sdug bsngal gyis sems gzer ④cing 'dug/kha cig ni chos nyid la brten 4sprenas gang 'di ltar bdag cag la bcom ldan 'das kyis zhib tu bstan te ④thams cad kyi snying du sdug cing phangs pa tsodaga' ba/yid du 'ong ba dang bral nas med pa dang / zhig pa dang / bye bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dge slong rnams rim gyis dal bu yidal bus zil gyis ma mnan na/ tshe bskal pa brgya phrag mang po thub pa'i lha rnams 'di ltar legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung 11—706

ba'i dge slong rnams so sor mi rtog ①par mang du gnas so zhes 'phya bar byed/smod par byed/ kha zer bar byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags ②pa la lha ji snyed yod pa shes sam zhes dris pa dang / kun dga' bo ji tsam grong khyer rtswa ②can gyi ④bar nas chu bo dbyig ldan gyi bar dang / ji tsam shing sā ⑤la zung gnyis kyi tshal gyi bar nas/ gyad kyis dbu rgyan btags pa'i mchod rten gyi bar dpag tshad bcu gnyis kho ra khor yug tu dbang che ba/ dbang che bar grags pa'i lha rnams kyis ma khyab cing ma gang ba cung yizad kyang med de/ chung ngu na khar ⑦ba gzugs pa'i khyon tsam yang med par lha kha cig ni sa la 'gre ldog /kha cig ni dpung pa nas bzung nas ku cho gye'adon/ kha cig ni sdug bsngal gyis sems gzer 0cing 'dug /kha cig ②chos nyid la brten nas/ gang 'di ltar bdag cag la bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑩rnam grangs du mar kun du bstan te/thams cad kyi snying du sdug cing phangs pa/ dga' ba dang ④yid du 'ong ba dang bral nas med pa dang / zhig pa dang / gyes ④par gyur to/ /de'i nub mo tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi gtam smras nas 'phags pa'i ngo bor cang mi smra bar ④'dug go/ /de nas de'i tsomatshan mo nam nangs nas tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo song la grong khyer rtswa 0can gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces gnas 'jog dag deng gi mtshan mo'i gung 0thun la ston pa phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyisatso/ khyed kyi bya ba dang sgrub yipa dag der rgyas la da phyin chad 'di skad ces grong gi nyen kor tshub dag bdag 11—707

cag gi ston pa phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su ①yongs su mya ngan las 'das te/ bdag cag gis de la mchod pa ②bya zhing brtson par bya ma ②nus so zhes yid la gcags par ma byed cig ④ces smros shig/tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas de skad smras nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa'i ltar mnyan nas snam sbyar blangs ⑤te dge slong gzhan dag dang / phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong dag dang / grong khyer rtswa yican gyi gyad rnams kyi 'dun khang ga la bar song ste phyin pa dang / de'i tshe grong khyer rtswa ༅can gyi gyad rnams kyi 'dun khang na gyad lnga brgya tsam zhig bya ba dag cig gi phyir 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos grong khyer rtswa ④can gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grong khyer rtswa ⑨can gyi gyad kyi 'khor mang po tshogs shing 'dus pa shes ldan gnas 'jog dag nyon cig /deng gi mtshan mo'i gung thun la ston pa phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su 0mya ngan las 'das kyis 7/ gang khyed 8kyis bya ba dang sgrub 8pa dag der byos la phyin chad 'di skad ces grong gi nyen kor ⑫ba dag bdag cag gi ston pa phung po lhag ma med pa'i chadabyings su yongs su ②mya ngan las 'das te/ bdag cag gis de la mchod cing brtson par byed ma ⑪nus so zhes yid la gcags 8par ma byed cig ces smras nas/ grong khyer rtswa ⑪can gyi gyad kha cig ni sa la 'gre ldog /kha cig ni dpung pa nas bzung nas ku cho 0'don/ kha cig ni sdug bsngal gyis sems gzir 0cing 'dug /kha cig ni chos nyid la brten nas gang 'di ltar bdag cag la bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam grangs du mar kun du bstan ④te/ thams cad kyi snying du sdug cing phangs 311—708

pa / dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang bral nas med pa dang / zhig pa dang / bye bar gyur to/ /de nas grong khyer rtswa ①can gyi rgyad rnams ji tsam ②grong khyer rtswa ②can gyi dri ④dang / phreng ba dang / bdug spos dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i cha byad ⑤dag thogs te/ de dag gi bu dang / chung ma dang /bran pho dang / bran mo dang / las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang /de dag gi mdza' bshes dang / nye du dang / blon po dang / snag gi gnyen mtshams rnams grong khyer rtswa ༅can nas byung nas ༅shing sā dul zung gnyis kyi tshal ga la ba der song ste 0phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das seng ge lta bur gzims pa la dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug spos dang / phye ma dang / rol mos ⑩bkur ster 7byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod par byas so/ /de nas gzhan yang grong khyer rtswa 8can gyi gyad gtso bo gtso bo rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung la bdag cag rnams kyis mchod par bgyi ba dang / brtson ⑫pa ji lta bur bsgrub par bgyi lags/ gnas 'jog dag 'di lta ste/ 'khor los ④sgyur ba'i rgyal po la bya ba bzhin no/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo 'khor los tsosgyur ba'i rgyal po la ji ltar bgyid lags/ gnas 'jog dag 'khor los ༅sgyur ba'i rgyal po la ni lus shing bal gyi 'da' bas dkri zhing shing bal gyi 'da' 0bas dkris yinas ras zung lnga brgyas dkri ⑩bar bya'o/ /ras zung lnga brgyas dkris ⑥nas lcags kyi sgrom bur 0bcug ste/ 'bru mar gyis bkang nas ④steng nas lcags kyi kha gab gnyis kyis bkab ste/ dri zhim po'i shing thams cad spungs te 3/des bsregs nas/ me de dag 'o mas bsad de de'i rus pa gser gyi bum pa'i 11—709

nang du bcug nas lam po che'i bzhi ①mdor rus pa'i mchod rten brtsigs nas gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan btsugs te/ dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur ster byed/bla mar byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed cing dus ston chen po yang byed do—/ /gnas 'jog dag 'khor los khusgyur ba'i rgyal po la bya ba de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la de bas kyang lhag par bya'o/ /btsun ①pa kun dga' bos gsungs pa'i don bdag cag gis 'tshal ba ltar na gang gi phyir bdag cag gis gdugs gcig gam/ gnyis sam / gsum gyis mi tshogs te sbyar bar dka' na zhag bdun tshun chad kyis bdag cag gis de bzhin du sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i khri la gzims pa la dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang /rol mo'i sgras bkur ster ④bgyi/ bla mar bgyi/ ri mor bgyi/ mchod par bgyi'o / /de bzhin du gyis shig ces tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ⑤ las thos nas / grong khyer rtswa ༅can gyi rgyad rnams ④nyi ma bdun pa nyid la shing bal gyi 'da' ba dag bsags te/ shing bal gyi 'da' ba dag bsags nas ras zung lnga brgya yang bsags/ ras zung lnga brgya yang bsags nas/ lcags kyi sgrom yang bshams/ lcags kyi sgrom bshams nas/ dri zhim po'i shing thams cad kyang spungs/ dri zhim po'i shing thams cad spungs nas gser gyi bum pa yang sta gon byas/ gser gyi bum pa sta gon byas nas gser gyi khyogs dag kyang bshams te / gser gyi khyogs bshams nas grong khyer rtswa ⑧can nas chu bo dbyig ldan gyi bar dang / shing sā ⑨la zung gi tshal nas rgyad kyis dbu rgyan btags pa'i mchod 11—710

rten gyi bar dpag tshad bcu gnyis thog thag ji tsam dri dang / phreng ba dang /bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i cha spyad ①dag thogs nas grong khyer rtswa ②can nas byung ste/ shing sā ③la zung gi tshal ga la bar song nas ④phyin pa dang /seng ge'i khri la gzims pa la dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang /phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur ⑤ster byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/mchod par byas so/ /gzhan yang grong khyer rtswa ⑤can gyi gyad gtso bo gtso bo dag gis grong khyer rtswa ༅can gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grong khyer rtswa ⑧can gyi gyad kyi 'khor mang po tshogs shing 'dus pa shes ldan gnas 'jog dag nyon cig /gyad kyi chung ma dang / rgyad kyi bu mo dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das la gos kyi bla re ⑨zas shig /gyad rnams yidang / gyad gzhon nu dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das kyi khyogs zung shig /nged cag gis ni dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur snyir bya(spre/bla mar bya/ ri mor bya 8/ mchod par bya ste/ grong khyer rtswa ༅can gyi nub sgo nas dbus thog thag tu zhugs nas grong khyer rtswa ④can gyi shar sgor byung ste chu bo dbyig ldan rgal nas gyad kyis dbu rgyan tsobatags pa'i mchod 0rten gyi drung du bzhugs su gsol la zhugs la bzhen ⑩par bya'o/ /de nas grong khyer rtswa 8can gyi gyad rnams kyis sngo'ede bzhin du bgyi'o zhes mnyan nas gyad kyi chung ma dang /rgyad kyi bu mo dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das la gos kyi gdugs ⑥ dag bres/ gyad rnams 0dang / gyad gzhon nu dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das kyi khyogs gdeg par 'dod nadu/ bcom ldan 'das kyi khyogs gdeg par ma nus pa dang /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags phyepas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces 11—711

smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo grong khyer rtswa ①can gyi gyad rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi khyogs gdeg par ma nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha rnams kyi bsam ②pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa lha rnams kyi bsam ③pa ji lta ④bu yin/ lha rnams kyis ni gyad kyi chung ma dang / gyad kyi bu mo dag gis na ⑤bcom ldan 'das la gos kyi bla re bre zhing / gyad rnams dang /gyad gzhon nu dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das kyi khyogs la bzung nas bdag 0gis lha'i dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur sti ༅bya/ bla mar bya/ ri mor byal/ mchod pa ⑨byas te/ grong khyer rtswa ⑪ can gyi nub phyogs kyi sgo nas dbus thog thag 7zhugs la grong khyer rtswa ⑫can gyi shar sgo nas byung ste/ chu bo dbyig ldan rgal nas gyad kyis dbu rgyan btags pa'i mchod 8rten gyi drung du bzhugs su gsol la zhugs la bzhen ④par bya'o zhes bsams so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa lha rnams kyis ji ltar bsams pa de bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos grong khyer rtswa 8can gyi rgyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan gnas 'jog dag bcom ldan 'das kyi yikhyogs gdeg ⑩ma nus pa de ④ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha rnams kyis bsams pa yin no/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo lha rnams kyis ji ltar bsams lags/ lha rnams kyis ni gyad kyi chung ma dang / gyad kyi bu mo dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gos kyi bla re bre zhing gyad rnams dang / gyad gzhon nu dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das kyi khyogs btegs teyi/ bdag cag gis lha'i dri dang /phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur ster rjo bya/bla mar bya/ ri mor bya/ mchod par byas nas/ grong khyer rtswa 0can gyi nub 11—712

phyogs kyi sgo nas dbus thog thag zhugs la grong khyer rtswa ①can gyi shar sgor byung ste/chu bo dbyig ldan rgal ②nas/ gyad kyis dbu rgyan btags pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du bzhugs su gsol la ②zhugs la bzhen ④par bya'o zhes sems sol/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo ji ltar lha rnams kyis bsams pa de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /de nas gyad kyi chung ma dang / gyad kyi bu mo dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das la gos kyi bla re bres/ gyad rnams dang / gyad gzhon nu dag gis ni bcom ldan 'das kyi khyogs bteg ste/ khyogs bteg ma thag tu bar snang la gnas pa'i lha dag gis lha'i me tog ut+pa la dang / pad ma dang / pad ma dkar po dang /ku mu da dang / a ga ༅ru'i phye ma dang / ta ma la'i phye ma dang / lha'i me tog man dā ⑦ra ba la sogs pa dag gis ni gtor/ lha'i rol mo'i sgra dag ni blangs / gos mang po dag ni bor ro/ /gzhan yang grong khyer rtswa ⑧can gyi gyad gtso bo gtso bo dag gis grong khyer rtswa 0can gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan gnas 'jog dag bdag cag gi mi'i rol mo'i cha spyad ⑩dag bor la/ bdag cag gis lha'i dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang /phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur snyi tho〉bya/ bla mar bya/ ri mor bya/mchod pa 'byas la/ grong khyer rtswa 8can gyi ④nub phyogs kyi sgo nas grong khyer rtswa ⑫can gyi shar sgor byung la/ chu bo dbyig ldan rgal tshunas gyad kyis ⑩dbu rgyan btags pa'i mchod 8rten gyi drung du bzhugs su gsol la zhugs la bzhen par bya'o zhes smras so// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/⑥ bam po lnga bcu rtsa drug du pa/ de nas grong khyer rtswa 0can gyi gyad rnams kyis mi'i rol mo'i cha spyad chadag bor te/ lha'i 11—713

dri dang / phreng ba ①dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur ster ②byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod ②par ④byas te/grong khyer rtswa ⑤can gyi nub sgo nas dbus thog thag tu rdzizhugs te/ grong khyer rtswa ⑦can gyi shar sgor byung nas chu bo dbyig ldan brgal ⑤te/ gyad kyis dbu rgyan btags pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du bzhugs ⑨su gsol lo/ /de'i tshe grong khyer rtswa 0can du lha'i me tog man dā yir ba mang po pus mo nub tsam du bab par gyur to / /de'i tshe 'tsho ba can gzhan zhig gis lha'i me tog man dā char tsob de las mang du blangs te yul sdig pa ④can du bya ba zhig gi ched du song ba dang / de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung tsochen po 'khor lnga brgya dang chas te/ yul sdig pa ⑩can gyi bar nas grong khyer rtswa ༅can gyi bar du lam du zhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung ma nyams pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'dod pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos 'tsho ba 8can de lam kur mthong ngo / /mthong nas 'tsho ba can de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'tsho ba can khyod gang nas 'dir 'ongs/ gang du 'gro7/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po bdag ni grong khyer rtswa du can nas 'dir mchis te/ bgyi ba zhig gi ched la yul sdig pa can du mchi'o / /tshe dang ldan pa 'tsho ba can khyod kyis ( 〉nga'i ston pa shes sam/'phags pa 'tshal lags te/ dge slong 3gi ta ma lags so/ /'phags pa 'od srung chen po ston pa de yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas deng du dgung bdun lon tshulags te/ de'i sku gdung la mchod ④pa bgyis pa'i lha'i me tog man dā ra ba chubadag gis blangs pa 'di lags so/ /de'i tshe rgan zhugs tsogazhan zhig tshul ma yin pa'i tshig 'di skad du smra 0ste/ 'di ltar bdag ni 'gyod pa dang 11—714

rgan zhugs kyis 'di ltar kye dge slong dag 'di ni ①bya ba'o/ /'di ni bya ba ma yin pa'o ②zhes smra ba las thar bar gyur te③/ da ④ni bdag cag gis gang nus pa de ni bya/ gang mi nus pa de ni mi bya'o zhes de skad du mi rigs ⑤par smra ba dang / bar snang la gnas pa'i lha dag gis bsgribs te/ ji ltar ༅tshe dang ⑦ldan pa 'od srung chen po ma gtogs ⑤pa dge slong gi 'khor ⑨de gcig gis kyang thos par ma gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos tshul ma yin pa'i tshig de lta bu smra ba gdul ba'i don du lam las gyur te⑩/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la stan bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos dge slong rnams la ⑩'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ mi brtan pa/ yid brtan du mi rung ba/ 'gyur ba'i chos can yin te/ ji srid du 'di ltar 'dus ④byas kyi chos thams cad la yid dbyung tsobar bya/ rnam par grol bar bya'o/ /kye tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung ma nyams pa blta bar ⑫rings par 'gro'o ⑫/ /de nas grong khyer rtswa 8can gyi gyad rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung la ⑩shing bal gyi 'da' bas dkrisatso/ shing bal gyi 'da' bas dkris yinas/ ras zung lnga brgyas dkris 0so/ /ras zung lnga brgyas dkris nyenas/ lcags kyi sgrom du bcug ste chu'abru mar gyis bkang ngo / /lcags kyi sgrom du bcug ste 'bru mar gyis bkang nas/ steng nas lcags kyi kha gab gnyis kyis bkab ste/ dri zhim po'i shing thams cad spungs nas zhugs la bzhen par 'dod na me spar bar ma 'anus so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun 11—715

dga' bo grong khyer rtswa ①can gyi gyad rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku ②gdung zhugs la bzhen par ma rgyanas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha rnams kyis bsams pa yin duno/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa lha rnams kyis ji ltar bsamasame / 'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa 'od sung chen po 'khor lnga brgya rjodang chas te yul sdig pa can gyi ⑦bar nas grong khyer rtswa ⑧can gyi bar du lam du zhugs tedu / bcom ldan 'das kyi tshusku gdung ma nyams pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'dong ba 0yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa ⑩ji ltar lha rnams kyis bsams pa de bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos grong khyer rtswa 0can gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grong khyer rtswa ④can gyi gyad kyi 'khor mang po tshogs shing 'dus pa shes ldan gnas 'jog dag nyon cig /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung zhugs la bzhen par ma nus pa de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha rnams kyis bsams pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo lha rnams kyis 'ji ltar bsams lags/ de ni tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po 'khor lnga brgya dang chas te ༷yul sdig pa 0can gyi bar nas grong khyer rtswa 8can gyi bar du lam du zhugs te bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung ma nyams pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'dong ba 7yin no//de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa kun dga' ⑦bo ji ltar lha rnams kyis bsams pa de bzhin du bgyi'o 0/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po grong khyer rtswa 3can du phyin pa dang / 'khor dag gis tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po 3rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i cha spyad chadag thogs te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen 11—716

po'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal ①te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po'i ②phyi bzhin du rjes su 'brang zhing song ngo / /①tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po 'khor brgya phrag du ma dang / 'khor stong phrag du ma dang / 'khor brgya stong phrag du ma dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / dri zhim po'i shing thams cad bsal ④rto/ /dri zhim po'i shing thams cad bsal nas lcags ⑤kyi sgrom yikha phye'o/ /lcags kyi sgrom ༅kha phye nas ras zung lnga brgya bshus so//ras zung lnga brgya bshus nas shing bal gyi 'da' ba yang bshus so/ /shing bal gyi 'da' ba ⑧bshus nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung ⑨ma nyams pa la phyag byas so//de'i tshe na sa chen po 'di'i steng na nyan thos chen po bzhi ⑩yod deyi/ tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi 8rgya dang / tshe dang ldan pa skul 'byed chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa stobs bcu 'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po'o/ /de dag gi nang na tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po ye shes dang ldan pa/ bsod nams che ba/ chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal stan dang / na ba'i rkyen sman dang / yo byad dag rnyed pa yin no/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po de 'di snyam du sems te/ ma la bdag nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las bya'o snyam du spro ba bskyed nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos shing bal gyi 'da' ba gzhan dag sta gon byas te/ shing bal gyi 'da' ba gzhan dag sta gon byas nas/ gzhan yang ras zung lnga brgya ④sta gon byas so/ /ras zung lnga brgya gzhan dag sta gon byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung la shing bal gyi 'da' bas dkris tho)so/ /shing bal gyi zla ⑩bas dkris ⑩nas ras zung lnga brgyas dkris 8so/ /ras zung lnga brgyas dkris yinas/11—717

lcags kyi sgrom du bcug ste 'bru mar gyis bkang ngo / /lcags kyi sgrom du bcug ste 'bru mar gyis bkang nas steng du lcags kyi kha gab gnyis kyis bkab ste shing dri zhim po thams cad spungs so/ /spungs nas phyogs gcig tu song ba dang / ji ltar de sangs rgyas rnams kyi ①sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus de rang 'bar bar ⑤gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung srungs pa de dag la bskor ba byas nas de'i tshe ③tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ rnam par 'dren pa rin chen sku mnga' ba/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gshegs/ /sangs rgyas sku la ras zung lnga brgya dang / /chos gos stong snyed kun du dkris gyur pa/ /nyid kyi gzi brjid kyis ni sku gdung dang / / kun du dkris pa ④rab tu tshig par gyur/ /de la chos gos gnyis ni ma tshig pa/ /nang rim ⑤dang ni phyi rim ⑥'di rnam gnyis/ /de nas grong khyer rtswa ④can gyi gyad rnams kyis me de dag 'o mas bsad pa dang /de nas 'o ma las shing bzhi skyes par gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ gser can dang /ser skya dang / rta don dang / u dum bā ⑧ra zhes bya ba yin no/ /de nas grong khyer rtswa 0can gyi gyad rnams kyis de'i sku gdung gser gyi bum pa'i nang du bcug ste / gser las byas pa'i khyogs kyi steng du bzhag nas dri dang / phreng ba dang /bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur ster ⑩byas/ bla mar byas / ri mor byas/ mchod pa ⑨byas te grong khyer rtswa 8can du phyin nas/der grong khyer mchog gi dbus su bzhugs su gsol nas dri dang / phreng ba dang /bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur ster 'byas/ bla mar byas / ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas so/ /de nas yul sdig pa can gyi gyad 11—718

rnams kyis grong khyer rtswa ①can du ②bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas deng du zhag bdun lon nas sku gdung la sku gdung gi mchod pa byed do zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang dpung ②gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che'i tshogs dang / rta'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon te/ grong khyer rtswa ༅can gyi gyad ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ grong khyer rtswa ⑤can gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grong khyer rtswa ༅can gyi gyad kyi 'khor mang po tshogs shing 'dus pa shes ldan dag nyon cig /bcom ldan 'das ni nged la yun ring po nas phangs shing sdug pa yin te/ de khyed ⑦kyi grong khyer gyi nyen kor ⑧du rten pa las yongs su mya ngan las 'das na spu/bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung sha bla ri ram gyi skal ba de 7nged la byin cig dang /de nged kyis yul sdig pa can du bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs la gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gzugs shing / dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur snyi 8bya/ bla rtsamar bya/ ri mor bya/ mchod par bobya ste/ mchod pa byabyas nas dus ston chen po yang bya'o/ /gnas 'jog dag bcom ldan 'das de ni nged la yang phangs shing sdug pa yin la/ nged kyi grong gi nyen kor tsodu rten pa las ⑩'das par gyur pas bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung sha 8ri ram gyi skal ba nged kyis sbyin par mi bya'o/ /gal te byin na de lta na ni legs/ ji ste ma byin par gyur na dmag gis dbrog go/ /grong khyer rtswa 7can gyi gyad rnams kyis de bzhin du bya'o zhes mnyan to/ /yul rtog 0pa g.yo ba na gnas pa'i rgyal rigs bu lu ka dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs na gnas pa'i rgyal rigs grod rgya ⑪11—719

dang / khyab 'jug gling na gnas pa'i bram ze dang / grong khyer ser skya na gnas pa'i rgyal rigs shākya dang / yul yangs pa can na gnas pa'i rgyal rigs lits+tsha bī ①rnams kyis ④kyang thos / yul ma ga ṅgā'i ④rgyal po lus 'phags ma'i bu ma skyes dgras kyang bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das te/ yul sdig pa can gyi gyad rnams dang / yul rtog pa g.yo ba'i rgyal rigs bu lu ka dang /grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi ༅rgyal rigs krod rgya yidang / khyab 'jug gling gi bram ze dang / yul ser skya na gnas pa'i rgyal rigs shākya dang / yul yangs pa can gyi rgyal rigs lits+tsha bī ༅rnams dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa go bskon te/grong khyer rtswa shecan du sku gdung la mchod pa byed cing der sku gdung gi skal ba len du song ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang yul ma ga ṅgā'i tsosna chen po la gtogs pa bram ze dbyar byed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dbyar byed ngas ni bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas sdig pa can gyi gyad rnams dang / yul rtog pa g.yo bo'i rgyal rigs bu lu ka dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal rigs krod rgya cadang / khyab 'jug gling gi bram ze dang / yul ser skya na gnas pa'i rgyal rigs shākya dang / yul yangs pa can gyi rgyal rigs lits+tsha bī ༅rnams dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa go bskon te/ grong khyer rtswa 8can du sku gdung la mchod pa byed cing der sku gdung gi skal ba len du song ngo zhes thos na8/ khyod kyis shes sam/ de bas na bdag cag kyang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa go bskon te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ④sku gdung gi skal ba blang bar bya'o/ /des lha de bzhin du go bskon par bgyi'o zhes smras nas/ des dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa go bskon te/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra yang glang po che la zhon pa dang /11—720

des bcom ldan 'das kyi ①yon tan rjes su dran pas brgyal bar gyur to/ /de nas glang po che las phab ste rta la bskyon pa dang / der yang brgyal bar ⑤gyur te/des smras pa/ dbyar byed ngas ②ni mi nus kyis④/ khyod nyid dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi ⑤pa go bskon te/ song la grong khyer rtswa ༅can gyi gyad rnams la nga'i bkas gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ⑦ba chung changam/ bskyod pa yang ngam/ 'tsho 'am༅/ stobs dang bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes nad dris la 'di skad ces/ shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das de 6 ni nga la yun ring po nas phangs shing sdug pa bla mar gyur pa yin te/ de khyed ⑩kyi grong gi nyen kor 8du yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur na/ shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung sha ri ram gyi skal ba tsang la byin cig dang / des na nga 6rgyal po'i khab tu bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs nyunyel/gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gzugs shing / dri dang /phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur stir phyebya/bla mar bya/ ri mor bya/ mchod par bya'o ⑩/ /mchod pa 8byas nas dus ston chen po yang bya'o zhes bsgo shigayo /lha de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes yul ma ga d+ma'i bu sna chen po la gtogs pa bram ze dbyar byed kyis rgyal po ma skyes dgra las 0mnyan nas dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa go bskon te/ grong khyer rtswa ④can ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / grong khyer rtswa ②can gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grong khyer rtswa ④can gyi gyad kyi 'khor mang po tshogs shing 'dus pa shes ldan dag nyon cig /shes ldan dag la yul ma ga ṅgā'i ④rgyal po lus 'phags ma'i bu rgyal po ma skyes dgra gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba 0chung ngam/11—721

bskyod pa yang ngam/ 'tsho'am/ stobs dang bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes nad 'dri ①zhing / 'di skad ces shes 0ldan dag bcom ldan 'das de ni nga la yun ring po lanas phangs shing sdug pa bla mar gyur pa yin te de khyed ④kyi grong gi nyen kor ⑤du yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur yin shes ldan dag ⑦bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung sha ri ram gyi skal ba nga la byin cig dang / des na nga durgyal po'i khab tu bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs la gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gzugs shing / dri dang /phreng spub dang / bdug pa zhu) dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur sti byanyunye/ bla mar bya/)/ ri mor byanyu)/ mchod par bya'o/ /mchod pa 8byas nas dus ston chen po yang bya'o zhes bka' stsal to/ /dbyar byed bcom ldan 'das de ni nged la yang yun ring po nas phangs 8shing sdug pa bla mar gyur pa yin te/ de nged kyi grong gi nyen kor skyedu yongs su mya ngan las 'das pas nged kyis de'i sku gdung sha ri ram gyi skal ba sbyin par mi bya'o/ /de nas yul ma ga d+ma'i 6 sna chen po la gtogs pa bram ze dbyar byed kyis grong khyer rtswa 6can gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gal te byin na de lta na ni ༅legs/ ji ste ma byin par gyur na dmag gis dbrog par bya'o/ /grong khyer rtswa du can gyi gyad rnams kyis 2de bzhin du bya'o zhes mnyan nas/ de dag gis rgyal po'i 'khor mang po 'dus pa mthong nas gyad kyi chung ma dang / gyad gzhon tson dag kyang mda' 'phong bslabs so/ /ji tsam na yul sdig pa can gyi gyad rnams dang / yul rtog pa g.yo ba'i rgyal rigs pu lu du )ka dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal rigs krod rgya ④dang / khyab 'jug gling gi bram ze dang / yul ser skya na gnas 11—722

pa'i rgyal rigs shākya dang / yul yangs pa can gyi rgyal rigs lits+tsha bī ①dang /yul ma ga d+ma'i ⑤sna chen po la gtogs pa bram ze dbyar byed rnams kyis dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che'i tshogs dang / rta'i ④tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung ④bu chung gi tshogs go bskon te/ grong khyer rtswa ⑤can gyi gyad rnams kyi drung du dmag brgal ba'i phyir lhags so/ /de nas grong khyer rtswa ⑥can gyi gyad rnams kyis rgyad kyi chung ma dang / khyad gzhon nu dag grong khyer gyi phyir ⑦bkod de dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che'i tshogs dang /rta'i ༅tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon te/ pha rol po'i dmag gi tshogs bdun po dag gi drung du dmag brgal ba'i phyir byung ngo / /de'i tshe bram ze'i rigs bre bo dang mnyam pa 'khor 'dus pa de nyid du 'ongs te/ de nas bram ze'i rigs bre bo dang mnyam pas rtsaphan tshun gnyis ka nas g.yul mang po bshams pa 'thabs hu par gyur na ring po skyemi thogs par gcig la 8gcig 'chi bar 'gyur bar 8rig nas g.yang gzhi bskor rtsote / grong khyer rtswa rtecan gyi khyad ga la ba der song ste phyin nas grong khyer rtswa byacan gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grong khyer rtswa macan gyi gyad kyi 'khor mang po tshogs shing 'dus pa shes ldan dag nyon cig /bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma de ni yun ring po nas bzod pa dang ldan pa/ bzod pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa yin no/ /shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma de bzod pa dang ldan zhing bzod pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa yin na sku gdung gi phyir phan tshun tsogacig la gcig gsod yipar byed pa ni ⑥ mi rigs pas 0kho bos bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma de'i bsku gdung cha brgyad du bgo bar spro bar byas ⑫/ gang gi phyir bum 11—723

par sku gdung bcug pa'i bum pa ①de kho bo la byin cig dang / des na kho bos bre bo'i grong khyer du bcom ldan 'das gau ta ma de'i sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs ②la gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gzugs shing / dri dang / phreng ②ba dang / bdug pa dang / ④rol mo'i sgras bkur ster ⑤bya'o//bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod pa ⑥bya'o/ /mchod pa ⑨byas nas dus ston chen po yang bya'o/ /grong khyer rtswa ⑧can gyi rgyad rnams kyis bram ze'i rigs bre bo dang mnyam pa la de bzhin du bya'o zhes mnyan to/ /de nas bram ze'i rigs bre bo dang mnyam pa yul sdig pa can gyi gyad rnams dang/ yul rtog pa g.yo ba'i rgyal rigs pu lu ⑨ka dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal rigs krod rgya ⑩dang / khyab 'jug gling gi bram ze dang / yul ser skya na gnas pa'i rgyal rigs shākya dang / yul yangs pa can gyi rgyal rigs lits+tsha bī skyodang / yul ma ga d+ma'i byasna chen po la gtogs pa bram ze dbyar byed ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/yul ma ga ṅgā'i 8sna chen po la gtogs pa bram ze dbyar byed la 'di skad ces smras so / /dbyar byed shes par gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das gau ta ma de cani yun ring po nas bzod pa dang ldan zhing bzod pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa yin no//bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma de bzod pa dang ldan blazhing bzod pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa yin na⑩/ shes ldan dbyar byed khyed 0sku gdung gi phyir phan tshun gcig la gcig gsod 8par byed pa ni ⑥mi rigs pas kho bos bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma de'i sku gdung de cha brgyad du bgo bar spro bar byas/ gang gi phyir bum par sku gdung bcug pa'i bum pa de kho bo la byin cig dang / des na kho bos bre bo'i ① grong khyer du bcom ldan 'das gau ta ma de'i sku gdung gi mchod rten 11—724

brtsigs la gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gzugs shing / dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / ༅rol mo'i sgras bkur ster ②bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ / mchod par byas nas ②dus ston chen po yang bya'o/ /yul ma ga ṅgā'i bsna chen po la gtogs pa bram ze dbyar byed la sogs ⑤pas bram ze'i rigs bre bo dang mnyam pa la de bzhin du bya'o zhes mnyan ༅to/ /de nas bram ze'i rigs bre bo dang mnyam༅pas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos ④te/ cha gcig grong khyer rtswa 0can gyi gyad rnams la byin no/ /des na grong khyer rtswa byacan gyi gyad rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs nas gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan btsugs nas dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang /rol mo'i sgras bkur stir ⑨ byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa ebyas te/ dus ston chen po yang byas so/ /cha gnyis pa ni yul sdig pa can gyi gyad rnams la/ cha gsum pa ni/ yul rtog pa g.yo ba'i rgyal rigs bu lu ka la/cha bzhi pa ni grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal rigs grod rgya chal/ cha lnga pa ni khyab 'jug gling gi bram ze la/ cha drug pa ni yul ser skya na gnas pa'i rgyal rigs shākya rnams la/ cha bdun pa ni yul yangs hu pa can na gnas pa'i rgyal rigs lits+tsha bī 8rnams la/ cha brgyad pa ni yul ma ga d+ma'i 8sna chen po la gtogs pa bram ze dbyar byed la byin te/ des na 0yul ma ga ṅgā'i 8rgyal po lus 'phags ma'i bu ma skyes dgras bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs te gdugs ⑩dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan btsugs nas dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i ⑦ sgras bkur 11—725

stir ①byas/ bla mar byas②/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa ①byas te/ dus ston chen po yang byas so/ /de nas grong khyer rtswa ④can gyi gyad rnams kyis gang gi phyir bum par sku gdung bcug pa'i bum pa de bram ze'i rigs bre bo dang mnyam pa la byin no/ /de nas bram ze'i rigs bre bos bre bo dang mnyam pa'i grong khyer du bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs te gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan btsugs nas dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur stir byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa ⑤byas te/ dus ston zhuchen po yang byas so/ /de nas de'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u n+ya gro dha skyes 'khor 'dus pa de nyid du 'ongs te/ de nas bram ze'i khye'u n+ya gro tsedhas grong khyer rtswa ⑧can gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grong khyer rtswa zucan gyi gyad kyi 'khor mang po tshogs shing 'dus pa shes ldan dag nyon cig /bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma de ni yun 6ring po nas bdag la phangs shing sdug pa yin te/ de khyed kyi grong khyer du yongs su mya ngan las 'das na7/ shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das de'i sku gdung zhugs la bzhen pa'i sol ba de bdag la byin cig dang / des na bdag gis yul n+ya gro madha can du bcom ldan 'das gi ⑫ ta ma de'i sol ba'i mchod rten brtsigs la/gdugs ④dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan btsugs 8shing dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur snyi ⑩bya'o/ /bla mar bya'o/ /ri mor ⑩bya'o/ /mchod pa tsobya'o/ / mchod pa byas nas ⑪dus ston chen po yang bya'o/ /grong khyer rtswa 0 can gyi gyad rnams kyis bram ze'i khye'u n+ya gro 0dha la sku gdung gi sol ba byin te/ bram ze'i khye'u n+ya gro tsodhas yul n+ya gro ⑫11—726

dha can du bcom ldan 'das kyi sol ba'i mchod rten brtsigs te gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan btsugs nas dri dang / phreng ba dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo'i sgras bkur stir ①byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod par ②byas te/ dus ston chen po yang byas so/ /de'i ②tshe 'dzam bu'i gling du bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gdung gi mchod rten brgyad dang /bum pa'i mchod rten dang dgu/ sol ba'i mchod rten dang bcur gyur to/ /spyan ldan sku gdung bre bo brgyad dag las④/ /bdun ni 'dzam bu ⑤blang ba'i mchod par thob/ /skyes bu ༅mchog de'i bre bo gang zhig ni/ /grong khyer sgra sgrogs klu ⑦yi rgyal pos mchod/ /skyes ⑧mchog de yi ⑨mche ba bzhi dag las/ /mche ba gcig ni rtsa gsum 'jig rten mchod/ /gnyis pa tshig 'dzin grong khyer yid 'ong na/ /gsum pa ka ling rgyal po'i yul na ste/ /skyes byamachog de yi ⑫mche ba bzhi pa ni/ /grong khyer sgra sgrogs klu yi rgyal pos mchod/ /mya ngan med rgyal skya snar bu gnas pas/ /mchod rten bdun po rgya cher 'aspel byas te/ /de yi mthu yis dbyig skye'adzin 'dir yang ni/ /smon lam dngos pos ④mngon par brgyan gyur te/ /'di ltar spyan ldan sku gdung de la ni/ /lha dbang klu dbang mi yi dbang po dang / /mi dang klu chadang gnod sbyin bdag po yis/ /rab tu bkur nas bkur sti ⑩mchod pa byas/ /rab mkhyen thugs rjes 7ldan pa stobs mnga' ba/ /shāka tso'akhrungs ma yig sgyur ⑥ ni byang chub ste/ /ka shir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur nas/ /grong khyer rtswa 0can brten nas mya ngan 'das/ /gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe dge slong brgyad khri yongs su mya ngan las 'das so phye/ /gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa mod 11—727

gal gyi bu chen po yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de'i tshe dge slong bdun khri yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de'i tshe dge slong khri brgyad stong yongs su mya ngan las 'das te/lha'i ①tshe bskal pa brgya ②phyag mang po thub pa dag ci bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung ③rab ni dud ④pa tsam du gyur te/ dge slong dbang yod pa dag kyang yongs su mya ngan las 'das pas ⑤bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo sde dang 'dul ba dang / ma mo dag mi sgrogs so zhes 'phya bar byed/ smod par byed/ kha zer bar byed do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos dge slong rnams la 'di skad ces ༅smras sol/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag shes par gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe dge slong brgyad khri yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe ⑦dge slong bdun khri yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /da 'dir bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe yang dge slong khri brgyad stong yongs su mya ngan las 'das te/ dge slong de snyed cig yongs su mya ngan las 'das pas lha'i bu dum bskal 0pa brgya phrag mang po thub pa dag ci bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab ni dud pa tsam du gyur te/ dge slong dbang yod pa dag kyang yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo sde dang /'dul ba dang / ma mo dag ⑩mi sgrogs so zhes 'phya bar byed/ smod yipar byed/kha zer bar byed pas de lta 8bas tson 'dir shog ④la 'dus shig /dge slong dag gis legs kyis ④de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes smras so/ /dge 'dun gyi dge skos gang yin/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po lags so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 11—728

'od srung chen pos tshe dang ldan pa gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang po tshur shog /khyod kyis gaṇ+ḍi rdungs ①la dge slong gi dge 'dun dag sdus ②shig /tshe dang ldan pa 'od sung chen pos de skad ①bsgo ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa gang pos tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung gi ltar mnyan nas rab kyi mthar phyin pa'i bsam gtan bzhi la snyoms par zhugs nas ji tsam ye shes mthong ba la khuzhugs pa de ⑤tsam du rnam ⑥par bltas nas/ de nas ting nge 'dzin de las langs te ⑦gaṇ+ḍi brdung bar brtsams so/ /des ⑧gaṇ+ḍi de ⑨brdungs pa dang / gcig ma gtogs yi pa yul tha dad na gnas pa'i dge slong gi yidage 'dun dgra bcom pa lnga brgya 'dus nas/ dge slong 'dus shing 'dug 8pa la tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung 8chen pos 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag dge slong gi dge 'dun 'dus pa las gang dag su ④ma 'ongs pa 8rtogs shig /dge slong dag gis yul tha dad pa na phyaganas pa'i dge slong dag la phan tshun rnam par bltas nas / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung mchen po la/ tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag ma gtogs pa dge slong mang po thams cad 'dus shing mchis lags so zhes smras so / /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa tsob lang bdag shing shi ri sha ku'i gzhal med khang stong pa na 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos tshe dang ldan pa gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang po tshur shog / tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag ga la ba der song la phyin nas/tho) tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag ① la 'di skad 0ces smros ④shig /'od srung la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams 'di skad du nad med par gyur cig /dge 'dun gyi bya ba cung zad cig yod pas myur du bos dushig ces byos shig /tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung 11—729

gis ①de skad smras pa dang 0tshe dang ldan pa gang pos tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung ②las mnyan nas ji ltar sems ④mnyam par bzhag na grong khyer rtswa can srinas mi ⑥snang zhing / shing ༅shi ri sha ku'i gzhal med khang stong pa na 'dug pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang po tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag gi rkang pa gnyis la mgo ⑧bos phyag 'tshal te/ tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'od srung la 0sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag nad med par gyur cig /dge 'dun gyi bya ba cung zad cig ⑩yod kyis 7myur du bos 8shig ces de skad zer rol/ /de 'dod chags dang bral ba yin yang byams pa'i bag 'chags kyis bsgos 8pas tshe dang ldan pa gang po bcom ldan 'das gdul ba'i don du 'jig rten gzhan du ma tsugegashegs sam/ dge slong gi dge 'dun 'thab pa dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed ⑩pa dang / mtshang ⑩mi 'dru'am/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mu stegs kyis 8kun du ma bzlog gam de dag 'dus nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun la gnod yipa ma byas sam / de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma dang 'dra ba la nyon mongs pas dkris du pa'i dbang du gyur pa dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / spyod pa pa ⑥dang / kun du rgyu dag gis brnyas par ma gyur tam/ ma rig pa'i mun pas yog 3pa'i blo gros can dag gis dge 'dun du'adus ④pa'i dbyen tsom byas sam/ gang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i chos dang 'dul ba la chos dang 'dra ba'i tshig dang yi ge dang lta ba'i dra ba ma byung ngam/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dag 11—730

klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / yid la byed pa dag las ①blo bsgyur nas 'dus shing bre mo'i gtam byed par ma gyur tam/ gang the tshom ②dang / yid gnyis la zhugs pa'i sems kyis chos ①ma yin pa la ni chos su chos la ni ④chos ma yin par 'dul ba ma yin pa la ni ⑤'dul bar/ 'dul ba la ni 'dul ba ma yin par ma bshad dam/ dge slong dag ⑥ser sna'i dri mas yog pas tshangs pa mtshungs pa glo bur du 'ongs pa rnams la kun du dga' bar bya ba'i chos drug la sogs pa mi byed cing khyad du gsod par ⑦mi byed dam/ gang rab tu byung ba ngan pa dag gis bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag bstan pa la ma dad par byas nas mu ⑧stegs can la rten par ma gyur tam/ gang dag log par 'tsho ba tshikun du ④spyod pa zhing bla rmo ba dang / nyo mtshong byed pa dang / rgyal po la rten cing 'tsho ba ltos par ma gyur tam/ gang dag sbyangs pa'i yon tan yang dag par blangs nas 8bas mtha'i gnas mal du brten ④pa las sbyangs pa'i yon tan 8de dag bor bar ma gyur tam/ dge sbyong ma yin pa dge sbyong du khas 'ches canas tshangs pa mtshungs ⑩par spyod pa 'khrug 8par mi byed dam/ de lta tsomod kyi jo bo ⑥ gang po sangs du )rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun zhes smras pa'i cirigs na 'od srung la sogs pa zhes smra'amabla/ cithugs rje chen po la goms ⑥par gnas pa kun du spyod pa la zhugs pa'i ston pa phung 0po lhag ma med pa'i mya tshungan las 'das pa'i dbyings su phyimya ngan las 'das pa la ma zhugs sam/ 'gro ba'i ru skya ⑥'dzin pa med pas ⑥ 'jig rten 'khrugs 0par ma gyur tam/ stobs bcu chadang ldan pa mi rtag pa'i stobs kyis 0non par ma gyur tam / sems can thams cad kyi ston pa bdag cag sad par byed pa'i mgon 11—731

po ma gzims sam/ sangs rgyas nyin byed ma nub bamal/ thub pa'i dbang po ②zla ba sgra can gyis ②bcom nas snang ba med par ma gyur tam/ sum bcu rtsa gsum na dbang phyug dpag bsam gyi shing dri zhim po byang chub kyi yan lag gi me tog gis mdzes par byas pa dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzang po bzhi dang ldan pa mi rtag pa'i glang po che smyon ④pas ma bcom mamaphye/ ye shes kyi sgron ma mi rtag pa'i rlung gis bdas yinas yongs su mya ngan las ma ⑦'das sam zhes smras so/ /de nas de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa gang pos tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ blo ldan bstan pa gnas bya'i phyir/ /nyan thos dge 'dun tshogs nas ni/ /de dag der ni 'dus gyur te/ /khyod la sdod cing de brtson byed/ /gru chen rgyal ba de zhig ste//ye shes ri yang spurnam par rnyil/ /bstan pa rab mchog ldan pa yi ⑨/ /dge slong mang po rnam par zhi/ /gyi na ma lags legs par ④ni/ /bdag ni pho nyar 'dir 'ongs nanyunye/ /bstan pa gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ /de bas khyod ni nges par bzhud8/ /de nas 6tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang po chog gis 6de skad ma byasmra shig /'gro chuba'i dus ma yin no/ — /'on kyang jo co gang po/ 'gro ba'i sgron ma mgon po bzhugs na ⑩der/ /bdag ni 'gro bar bya ba'i 6blo yod kyang / /de nas ⑪pha rol rab zhi gshegs gyur na/ /blo ldan gang zhig 'jig rten de dag 'gro/ /lhung bzed chos gos rnam gsum mchog 'di dag /khyod kyis dge 'dun ⑥ dag la dbul bar gyis/ /bdag ni zhi ba yang srid med par 'gros0/ /bdag gis bsams pa 'phags pa 'bazod par cugasol/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag gis spar ba dang / dro ba dang / char dbab pa dang / gsal 11—7 32

ba mchog dag ①gi cho 'phrul chen po bstan te/ phung ②mo lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su ②mya ngan las 'das so/ /de'i lus rang las byung ba'i me'i khams kyis rnam par tshig ste de las chu'i rgyun rnam ④pa bzhi bab po/ /chu'i rgyun ⑤gcig las sgra bsgrags pa'i dbyangs kyi 0rjes su bstan pa/ da ltar dus rnams ngan gyur te/ /sems can rang gi ⑦las la brten / /'gro ba'i sgron ma de 'das pas/ /thams cad 'gro bar ⑨'jug par 0rtogs/ /gnyis pas smras ⑪pal/ 'dus byas bsags pa skad cig 'jig 8'gyur te/ /skye la sogs pa sdug bsngal nyon mongs ldan/ /so so'i skye bo bdag tu nga rgyal te/ /de dag byed pa med par rig par byedaci/ /gsum pas smras pa/ mkhas pa ④rtag tu dogs pas ④bag yod cing / /bsod nams yid la bya ba skyede brtson bya/ /'byung po'i tshogs kun song zhing 'jig 'gyur te/ /srog cadang bcas pa'i dpal ni g.yo bar gyur/ /bzhi pas smras pa8/ thub pa de la slob ⑥mchog yang dag btud / /rang gi dgos pa ma lus thams cad byas/ /gus shing rab tu dad pas bla ma de'i/ /phyi bzhin ba lang bdag kyang de ltar song / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang pos tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag gi rus pa du la rus pa'i mchod pa byas nas lhung bzed ⑥dang chos gos blangs te ji ltar sems mnyam par gzhag na shing shi ri sha ku'i 'gazhal med khang nas mi snang zhing grong khyer rtswa zhucan gyi gyad rnams nye bar rten pa dang / shing sā ④la zung gi 'tshal du gnas par bya ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang a+yopo 'od srung la sogs pa dge slong lnga brgya tshug la ba der song ste phyin phyonas ji ltar rgan rims tshul phyag 'tshal te lhung bzed dang chos gos rgan pa la ⑥ byin 11—733

nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /mgon po'i sku ①ni med par des thos nas/ /bsod rgyanams las kyis rab tu zhi bar song / /de yi ②lhung bzed chos gos ④'di yin te/ /des bsams dge 'dun dag la bzod par ⑤gsol/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos dge slong rnams dul 'di skad ces smras so//kye tshangs pa mtshungs ⑦par spyod pa dag nyon cig /ji ltar de ni 'phags pa'i tshul gyis 'das/ /gzhan gyis de bzhin rab zhir 'gro ⑧mi bya/ /de bas ⑨ji sh+yisrid dgos pa'i don bya zhing / /dbang chen 0tshogs nas de srid bgro bar 0bya//de nas yang tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos dge slong de dag brtan par bya ba'i tsophyir smras pabya/ ji ltar bsod 8nams las kyis zhi ⑩gyur pa/ /shi ri sha ku'i sems mchog ba lang bdag /de ltar khyed kyis de bzhin mi bsam ste/ /'gro don dgos phyir tshogs nas blo gros bya/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung ⑩chen pos dge slong lnga brgya 8po de dag la khrims ⑥su bcas nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag ji 0skad smra ba ⑥gson cig /ji ltar bdag cag gis chos kyi tshul ji lta ba bzhin bshad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang rnam par bral ba'i sdug bsngal can gyi (spredage slong phyogs dang ljongs gang dang gang na gnas pa de dang ⑥de dag gis thos nas 'dir 'ongs te/ de dag gis bdag blagi ⑥sems g.yeng bar byed mod kyi/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis yul ma ga ṅgār 0byang chub cing / gang du bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi sku brnyes 0pa der chos kyi tshul bgro bar bya'o/ /de na chadage slong gcig gis 0legs kyis ⑥de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes smras so/ /gzhan zhig 0kyang tshe dang ldan pa ci byang chub kyi 9shing drung du 'dong ngam/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos smras pas/ tshe dang 11—734

ldan pa yul ma ga ṅgā'i ①rgyal po lus 'phags ma'i bu ma skyes dgra rtsa ba med pa'i dad pa dang ②ldan pa de dge slong ③gi dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang /chos kyi tshul rab tu sbyor bar byed cing zhal ta yang byed pas rgyal po'i khab tu 'dong ngo / /de dag gis smras ④pa/ legs kyis ⑤de bzhin du bgyi na/ de lta na yang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ni slob pa'i dubya ba dang bcas pa yang yin na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang mdo sde ⑦mtha' dag gtad na/ de la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag gal te de lta na slob pa'i bya ba dang bcas pa'i dge slong gzhan 'khod pa de dag kyang 'khrug par 'gyur bas de la thabs kyi rnam ⑧pa zhig byas la/ 'di chu'i zhal ta bar bsko ba'i spro ⑨bas bskos la lhag ma ni bzlog par bgyi'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/ legs kyis de skyabazhin du bgyi'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung 0chen pos tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo khyod dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi chu'i zhal ta bar 0spro'am/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po spro'o / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las bya bar brtsams nas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi spre)zhal ta ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nye ba na 'dug cing bya/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang mdo sde mtha' dag gtad de/ de lta 8bas na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dge 'dun gyi chu'i zhal ⑩ta bar bsko ⑩ste/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo chu'i zhal ta bar bsko na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi 8dus la bab cing bzod na/ skya bodage 'dun 11—735

gyis gnang ①bar mdzod cig dang / dge slong kun dga' bo chu'i zhal lta ba chu 'brim ②par bsko ste/ dge slong kun dga' bo chu'i zhal ta ba chu 'brim ③par 'gyur ro/ /za④'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ni bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal ta ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ①nye ba na 'dug cing / de la bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde mtha' dag gtad de/ de lta dubs na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dge 'dun gyis dge 'dun la chu 'brim par bsko stergya/tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ⑧dge 'dun la chu 'brim ⑨na/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dge 'dun la chu 'brim ⑩par bsko zhing / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dge 'dun la chu 'brim 0par tshe dang ldan pa gang dag bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung 0shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung 0shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dge 'dun la chu 'brim byapar bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung byabs de de bzhin du 'dzin to// // 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi/skya bam po lnga bcu rtsa bdun ⑩pa/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung tsochen pos tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' yibo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kun dudaga' bo khyod tshur shog /dge slong gi dge 'dun dang lhan cig ci dga' bar ljongs rgyus la rgyal po'i khab tu song shig /nga ni lam drang po nas 'gro'o/ /btsun pa de bzhin bgyi'o zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dge slong gi dge 'dun ⑥dang ci dga' bar ljongs rgyu zhing song ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung phyechen po yang snga ma bzhin lam drang po nas rgyal 0po'i 11—736

khab tu song ngo / /yul ma ga d+ma'i ①rgyal po lus 'phags ma'i bu ma skyes dgra'i spyod pa ni gang du glang po che la zhon te/ bcom ldan 'das mthong na de ma thag tu rang lhung nas/ de bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus mnyams par sa la 'jog go//yul ma ga d+ma'i ②rgyal po ma skyes dgras tshe dang ldan pa 'od sung ①chen po ④mthong ste / mthong nas bcom ldan 'das rjes su dran nas ⑤de bzhin du rang sa la lhung ba dang / de tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po'i rdzu ⑥'phrul gyis bzung nas smras pa/ rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag ni rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa lags la/ nyan thos dag ni mnyam par ma bzhag par ye shes mthong ba mi 'jug ste/ de res 'ga' ni de bzhin du mnyam par bzhag nas gnas ⑦ / res 'ga' ni mnyam par ma bzhag par gnas pas da phyin chad khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos mthong na glang po che dudang rta las rang ⑨lhung bar ⑩ma byed cig ces der khrims bcas so/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa ji skad bka' stsal pa de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /'phags pa 'on kyang gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das chubazhugs pa de'i tshe 8bcom ldan 'das la bkur snyi rtsabagyid na/'di ltar bcom ldan 'das ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das na ④/ da bdag gis gang zhig la bkur sti ④bgyi lags/ de lta yibs na bdag la bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa gtad do zhes smras nas/ blon po la shes ldan 'phags pa 'od srung chen po'i dgos pa thams cad sbyor cig ces bsgo'o / /tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung 0chen pos smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das ni yul ma ga d+mar tsobyang chub ste/ der bcom ldan 'das kyis yi chos kyi sku 0 brnyes pa⑥/ dge slong gi dge 'dun 6rnams lam du zhugs 11—737

te lha'i gnas 'dir chos kyi tshul bgro ①bar 'tshal lags so/ /des ②smras pa/'phags pa legs kyis ③bdag gis dge slong gi dge 'dun la yo ④byad thams cad bstabs ⑤par bgyi'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung la sogs pa dgra bcom pa lnga brgya po rnams mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / chos mngon pa bsdu ⑥bar bya ba'i phyir rgyal po'i khab tu phyin pa dang / yul ma ga ṅgā'i ⑦rgyal po lus 'phags ma'i bu ma skyes dgras dgra bcom pa lnga brgya rgyal po'i khab tu phyin par thos so/ /thos nas kyang grong khyer dag byi dor byas te lam dag bstan ninasal/ btsun mo dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / pho brang 'khor gyi ༅mi rnams kyis bsu'o ⑩/ /de nas skyes bu bzang po stong gis zhabs ⑩'bring byas nas rab tu mdzes par byas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams grong khyer du phyin nas yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs ④so/ /de nas rgan rims 'akyis 'dug pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa phyogs gang du bgro ④bar bgyi/ des smras pa/ rgyal po chen po ⑫'od ma'i 7tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa 'dir yang dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa dang bral te sdug bsngal skyes pas biphyogs dang ljongs dang tsogang dang gang na gnas pa de dang yide dag 'dir mchis te/ des bdag cag gi ⑥sems g.yeng ba'i skyon mchis so/ /bya rgod kyi phung 0po'i ri la yang de bzhin du nyes dmigs mchis te/ shing n+ya 'gro dha'i phug 'di ④ni rab tu dben mod kyi 'on kyang mal stan ma mchis lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod kyis sems skyed ④cig dang mal stan mchis so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag rgyal po ni 'di skad ces/ shing n+ya gro dha'i 11—738

phug 'dir 'gro ①bar bya'o zhes zer ro/ /dgra bcom pa lnga brgya po rnams kyang cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'phags pa 'od srung chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang bdag la ma sbran ②pa kho nar yongs su mya ngan las du'adas so/ /khyod kyis kyang ma brtags par yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ④bar ma mdzad cig /tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos kyang de bzhin du gnang ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od sung chen pos je ⑤dang por dbyar sbyor ba ral ⑥ba dang / 'drums pa dag bcos nas/ phyis ⑦dbyar gnas par khas blangs te chos bgro bar bya'o snyam du bsams nas des dang por dbyar sbyor ⑧ba ral ba dang / 'drums pa dag bcos ⑨nas phyis dbyar gnas par khas blangs sol/ — /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i sems la kun tu bltas yinas tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa la 'di skad ces smras sol/ /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa dgongs shig /'khor 'di de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu bsngags ⑩pa'i nang na dge slong 'dod chags dang bcas pa/zhe sdang dang bcas pa/ gti mug dang 8bcas pa'/ sred pa dang bcas pa/len pa dang bcas pa slob pa dag 8yod do/ /de nas tshe dang 8ldan pa ma 'gags ⑩pas bsam gtan bzhi pa pyal snyoms par zhugs te rnam par brtags na / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo gcig pu 'dod chags dang bcas8/ zhe ⑩sdang dang bcas0 / gti mug dang bcas/ srid pa dang ⑥bcas/ len pa dang bcas te slob pa yin par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa 'od sung chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'od sung tsochen po mkhyen par mdzod cig /dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams ni snying po med pa dang 11—739

bral ba①/ dag pa/ gtsang ba/ snying po can/ bla na med pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing / 'jig rten gyi sbyin gnas yin mod kyi/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ni 'dod chags dang bcas/ zhe sdang dang bcas/ gti mug dang bcas / sred pa dang bcas/ len pa dang bcas pa yin te slob pa yin no/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la ci spro ba byas pas gdul ②bar 'gyur ramacha/ 'on te spyo bas 'dul bar 'gyur ba rnam par brtags na/ ji tsam spyos nas ④'dul bar mthong nas des de la nged ni 'dus pa'i ⑤mchog yin ⑥la/ kun dga' bo khyod dang nged lhan cig chos bgro bar mi byas/ khyod longs ⑦ shig ces smras pa dang / de gnad du phog pa bzhin ⑧du rab tu g.yos nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po chog gokhya/ /bdag gis tshul khrims nyams par ma byas/ lta ba nyams par ma byas/ spyod pa 8nyams par ma byas ⑩/ 'tsho ba nyams par ma byas te/bdag gis cung zad kyang dge 'dun la nyes pa ma byas mod kyi ⑫/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po bzod pa mdzod cig /des tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 8'bring nye ba 8na 'dug 'dug 8pas tshul khrims nyams par ma byas pa dang / lta ba nyams par ma byas pa dang / spyod pa nyams par ma byas pa dang / 'tsho ba nyams par ma byas pa lta 0ngo mtshar ci ⑩che / ngas dge 'dun la 8nyes pa cung 7zad kyang ma byas so zhes smra bar byed dam / longs la tshul shing 0zung shig dang / khyod kyi nyes pa bstan par ⑩bya'o zhes smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo langs so de langs ma thag 0tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi 0khams lan 11—740

gsum du g.yos①/ rab tu g.yos/ kun du ②g.yos/ 'gul/ rab tu 'gul / kun du rab tu 'gul te/ nam mkha' la gnas pa'i lha dag ngo mtshar du gyur nas mig phye ④ste a la la zhes smras nas/ kye ma ④'phags pa 'od srung ①chen po ⑥bden par smra ba⑦/ phan par smra ba yin na⑤/ da 0ltar thub pa lus 'phags kyi gnas 'di na 'phags pa kun dga' bo la rab tu drag pas spyo bas spyo bar chubyed do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen pos tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo khyod na re ngas dge 'dun la gnod pa ci ༅yang ma byas so zhes 7zer na/ ji ltar khyod kyis dge 'dun la gnod pa ma byas pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das ni bud med rnams gnas ngan len kun 8tu spyod pas rab tu dbyung bar mi bzhed na khyod kyis gsol ba btab ste ④/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo bud med rab tu dbyung 8zhing bsnyen par rdzogs te/ dge slong ma'i dngos po 'thob ⑩par 'gyur ba nga ༅la ma smra 8shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo chos 'dul ba la bud med rab tu phyung na ⑩'di ltar chos 'dul ba yun dzu ring du gnas par mi 'gyur te/ dper na 'bras sā byalu phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing la ser ba bab na 'bras sā 3lu gang yin pa de lhag 0cing med par 'gyur ba de bzhin du chos 'dul ba 'di la bud med rab tu phyung na chos 'dul ba yun ring du ④ gnas par mi 'gyur ro zhes ma gsungs sam/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po chog gis ( sprebazod pa 0mdzod cig /ngo tsha 0med pa dang / 'dzem pa 9med pa ni ma lags mod kyis0/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi sru skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gi ta sbos ⑥ dka' ba spyad de/ gang bcom ldan 'das kyi yum 0ni dus las 11—741 —

'das te rang gis ①nu ma bsnun nas gsos ②shing bskyed ③pa dang / gzhan yang sngon gyi ④dus na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la 'khor bzhi yod pa de ⑤bzhin du gang bcom ldan 'das 'di la ⑥yang de bzhin du 'gyur ro snyam pa dang / bdag gis byas pa gzo ba dang / nye du dang gnyen pas bud med rab ⑦tu dbyung bar gsol ba bgyis te de gcig pu nongs pa ni bzod pa ⑧gsol lo/ /kun dga' ⑨bo khyod kyis de ltar byas pa gzo ⑨ ba ni chos kyi sku ⑩la gnod pa byed pa yin te/ ji ltar khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing phun sum ⑫tshogs pa la ser ba bab 0pas lo stong tshang bar gnas pa'i yun 8thung ngur lhag ma tsam du byas na ji ltar nye du dang gnyen blagyi phyir zhes ⑩smra/ gnyen gyi phyir rab tu phyung ba ni mtshul ma yin zhing legs 8pa ma yin te nyes pa yin no/ /ji ltar sngon gyi skyodus na yang dag par du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la 'khor bzhi yod par phyangs thos te/ gang bcom ldan 'das 'di la yang de bzhin du 'gyur ro zhes smra ba yang de sngon gyi dus na mi rnams ni 'dod pa chung ba/ nyes pa chung ba/'dod chags chung ba/ zhe snang chung ba/ gti mug chung ba/ kun tu sbyor ba srab pa yin te/ de dag ni de ltar rigs kyi ༄ )'di ni rigs pa ma yin te/'di ltar bcom ldan 'das mi bzhed bzhin du ji lta ciji ltar khyod kyis gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du grub par gyur to/ /de bas na 'di ni nyes pa dang po yin te / tshul shing zhog shig /khyod la nyes pa gzhan yang yod de kū/ gang bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo gang dang gang du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi po la bsten cing bsgoms ⑤te lan grangs mang du byas na 'dod na bskal pa'am cibaskal pa las lhag par 0yang gnas par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs tson/ 'di — 11—742

ltar khyod kyis ①bcom ldan 'das la bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten la phan par bgyi ba'i slad du bskal pa'i bar du ②bzhugs su ②gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bskal ④pa bas lhag par bzhugs su gsol zhes ⑤gsol ba ma btab bo/ /des smras pa/ btsun pa 'od srung chen po ngo tsha med pa dang / yi'adzem pa med pa ni ma lags mod kyi/ 'on kyang bdag de'i tshe bdud sdig can gyis khyab par gyur to/ /de ltar de nyid ⑦khyod kyi nyes pa chen po yin te/ ston pa ni dri nga ba spangs pa/ bdud kyi stobs zil gyis gnon pa yin na/ ji ltar khyod ⑧bdud sdig can gyis khyab par gyur⑨/ de ltar 'di ni khyod kyi tshunyes pa gnyis pa yin nol/ /gzhan yang khyod la nyes pa 'di dag yod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' phab nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 'di lta bu'i zhes bka' stsal te gzhan smras 7pa na lan gzhan du 'debs tertsa/ de ltar 'di ⑫yang khyod kyi nyes pa gzhan cigasum pa yin no/ /gzhan yang khyod kyi ④nyes pa 'di dag yod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi na bza' gser gyi kha dog can phrugs gcig la rkang pas brdzis so rkye/ /btsun pa 'od sung chen po bdag ⑩des ngo ⑫ tsha med pa'am/ rab tu ngo tsha ba ni med pa ma lags mod kyi/ de'i tshe na g.yas g.yon nas dge slong grogs byed pa med do zhes smras pa dang / des ⑥khyod kyis nam mkha' la ci nyes te mi dor/ 'on kyang lha rnams kyis gzung bar 'gyur na zhes smra ste0/ 'di ni khyod kyi 0nyes pa bzhi pa'o/ /gzhan yang khyod kyi ⑫nyes pa 'di dag yod de/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan 'da' bar 0zhugs te/shing sā la ༷zung gi drung du bskyems pa dang / chu rtog pa sacan gsol to/ /btsun pa 'od srung chen po 0ngo tsha ba ②med pa'am/ rab tu ngo tsha ba med pa ⑥ni 11—743

ma lags mod kyi/ de'i tshe na shing rta lnga brgya tsam zhig chu bo ka kus sta brgal ①bas rnyog pa can du gyur to/ /de'i phyir khyod kyis nyes pa yin mod/ de na khyod kyis ②lhung bzed nam mkha' la ji ②ste mi bzung / lha dag gis chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa dag gis bkang bar 'gyur ba 'di yang khyod kyi ④nyes pa lnga pa'o/ /gzhan yang khyod la nyes pa 'di dag yod de༅/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa ngas ༅zla ba phyed phyed cing so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa de'i tshe gang gis tshul khrims phra mo dang / phran tshegs dag 'don na/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis phyir klod ⑦la bde ba'i reg pa la gnos dushig ces byung na ⑨de'i tshe khyod kyis tshul khrims bslab pa phra mo dang / phran tshegs ⑩gang lags zhes ma zhus pa'i phyir ro/ /de 'dir bdag gis smra ba yini ༅pas pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi dang / dge 'dun gyi ④lhag ma bcu gsum gyi chos dang / ma nges pa'i chos gnyis dang spang ba'i ltung byed kyi chos sum bcu dang / ltung byed kyi chos dgu bcu dang / so sor bshags par bya ba'i ④chos bzhi dang / /slab pa'i chos mang po rnams las lhag pa ④rnams ni phra mo dang phran tshegs rnams so/ /gzhan yang 'di skad zer te/ phas pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi dang / snga ma bzhin du so sor bshags par bya ba'i chos bzhi'i bar dang / de bas lhag pa ⑩rnams ni phra mo dang phran tshegs rnams so/ / gzhan yang 'di skad zer te⑩la/ pas pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi dang / dge 'dun gyi 8lhag ma'i chos chabacu gsum dang / ma nges pa'i chos gnyis dang / spang ba'i ltung byed kyi 0 chos sum bcu ⑥dang / ltung byed kyi chos tsodagu bcu rnams lhag pa ⑥ni phra mo dang 'phran tshegs rnams so/ /gzhan yang 'di skad zer te/ phas pham 11—744

par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi dang / dge 'dun gyi lhag ma'i chos bcu gsum dang /ma nges pa'i chos gnyis dang / spang ba'i ltung byed kyi chos ①sum bcu rnams las ②ma gtogs pa lhag pa ②rnams ni phra mo dang phran tshegs rnams so/ /gzhan yang 'di skad zer te/ phas pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi dang /dge 'dun gyi lhag ma'i chos bcu gsum dang / ma nges pa'i chos gnyis las lhag pa ④rnams ni phra mo dang phran tshegs rnams so ⑤zhes bya'o/ /de ltar dge slong gis khong yidu chud pa nas ༅pas pham par 'gyur ba bzhi la gnas shing /kha cig ni dge 'dun gyi lhag ma'i chos bcu gsum la gnas pa mu stegs can gyis skabs rnyed de/ dge slong zhugi ta ma'i chos ni dud pa bzhin du gyur to ⑨/ /dge sbyong 0 gi ta ma bzhugs pa'i tshe ni nyan thos kyi skyebaslab pa yang dag par sdom zhing / da ltar ni ci dga' bar spyod cing lhod par gyur te/ 'dod na ni de bzhin du byed/ mi 'dod na ni mi byed do/ /de bas na 8khyod kyis rtsam 'ongs pa'i skye ⑩ bo rnams la phan par bya ba'i 8phyir bcom ldan 'das la ma tsozhus pa nyes so/ /btsun pa 'od sung chen po ngo tsha ba 8med pa'am/ rab tu ngo tsha ba ⑫med pa ni ma lags mod kyi/ bdag de'i tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa ༅dang bral ba'i mya ngan ༅dran pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir to/ /de yang khyod kyi ༅nyes par gyur te 3/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs 0'bring byed la/ 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag pa ④yin na/ khyod kyis mya ngan byas pa de yang nyes so/ /gzhan yang nyes pa 'di dag yod de/ khyim pa'i 'khor dang / bud med spyod pa ngan pa rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdoms ④kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa bstan to / /btsun pa 'od srung ngo tsha ba med pa'am/ rab tu ngo tsha ba ⑥med 11—745

pa ni ma lags mod kyi ①bdag gis 'di snyam du bsams so/ /bud med ni rang bzhin gyis 'dod chags che bas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdoms kyi sba ②ba spubs su nub pa mthong na mo ③mtshan dang bral bar 'gyur ro④/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo khyod de lta bu'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa ga las byung / mdoms ⑤kyi sba ba ༅sbubs su ⑦nub pa ⑤bstan ⑨na bud med dag bud med yikyi mo 7mtshan ji ltar spong bar 'gyur ba 'di dang 8nyes pa rnam pa bdun no/ /8gzhan yang khyod la nyes pa 'di dag yod de ④/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gser gyi kha dog ltar 8ser ba bud med dag la bstan pas/ de la mchi mas dri ma can du gyur pa'o skye / /btsun pa 'od srung chen po ngo tsha med pa'am/ rab tu ngo tsha med pa ni ma lags mod kyi bdag gi blo skyes pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu'i kha dog dang ldan pa mthong na/ sems can mang po dag kha dog dang ldan par sems kyis smon lam bskyed ④par 'gyur ro④/ /kun dga' bo khyod gcig tu shes pa ma yin zhing / gzhan gyi sems shes pa ma yin pa 'di dang / nyes pa brgyad do / /khyod 'dod chags cung ༅zad dang ldan pas/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i du mchog 'dus pa'i nang du ma 'dug par/ da langs 0te song shig 3 /khyod dang lhan cig yang dag pa'i bzlas pa mi bya'o/ /de ltar tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la/ tshe dang tsoldan pa 'od srung chen pos nyes pa byas pa/ rnam pa brgyad glengs ④pa dang / phyogs bzhir bltas te ④snying rje bludang / sdug bsngal ba'i tshig gis dal bus smras pa/ kye ma'o nga'i ⑦dus ni 'di 'dra bar gyur te/ bdag de bzhin gshegs pas ni spangs/ mgon dang skyabs byed pa ni med/ snang tsob yang med na su la brten ⑥par bya/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa 11—746
