pa de lam ring po nas 'ongs pas ngal so ①zhing de 'dug tu bcug la bdag phyogs tshol du 'gro'o snyam du rig nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa la 'di skad ces/tshe dang ldan pa grags pa khyod lam ring po nas 'ongs pas khyod ngal so ②la ngas phyogs btsal bar bya'o zhes smras nas de ngal sor ④bcug ste/ tshe dang ldan pa nam gru phyogs tshol zhing song ngo / /de nas yangs pa can gyi dge slong rnams tshe dang ldan pa grags pa dang lhan cig gnas pa'i nye gnas dge slong gang na ba der song ste phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa tshe dang ldan pa'i mkhan po gar song zhes dris so/ /des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa de phyogs tshol du song ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa de ci'i phyir ༅phyogs tshol du song / tshe dang ldan pa dag gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya ba'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa nged kyis ci zhig byas na des nged rnams gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya/ des rgyas par bzlas pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa de legs pa ma yin pa zhig byed de/ ston pa 'das pa de'i gsung rab la rnam pa de dang 8de dag gis 'tsho tho bar rung na nged rnams 3ci'i phyir mtho btsamadu/ de de nyudag las gzhan zhig gis drang ba'i rtsasems dang phan pa'i brlang byatshig gis de dag la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag nyustekhyed ni rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa dang / rung ba ma yin pa dang /dge sbyong gi tsu)tshul ma yin pas spyod de/ des kyang ⑨ bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑫bstan pa lo stong du gnas par 'gyur ro zhes sngon thos na tsu9khyod kyis ni ma ⑩'ongs pa'i bstan pa nyid kyang mi snang bar byed pa la zhugs pa dang / ji ltar gzhan dag kyang gang dag bslab 8pa lhod par zhugs shing chu bur gyi ⑩rnam pa ⑥'di lta bu bskyed pas de bas na bstan pa gnas par bya ba'i phyir khyed rnams nges 11—796

par gnas nas dbyung ba'i las byed do zhes smras pa dang / de dag skrag nas spobs ①pa med de cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /de nas gcig nas gcig tu song ste gtam brjod par brtsams ②pa/ tshe dang ldan pa grags pa ni ③phyogs tshol du song nas bdag cag gnas nas dbyung ba'i las byed na ci'i phyir sems las chung ngur 'dug /ji ltar bsgrub par bya ba smos 0shig /de nas gcig cig gis smras pa/ ci zhig bsgrub tu yod/ ⑤gang de phyogs tshol du song na bdag cag gis kyang phyogs btsal mod/ ci'i phyir dubadag cag mi gnas par bya/gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa de ⑦dang bdag cag rtsod par 'gyur bar dubros te 'gro bar bya'o/ /gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ bdag cag gang du 'gro ste gang du song ba der yang de bzhin du nyes dmigs su 'gyur bas bzod pa ⑨gsol bar bya'o/ /gzhan zhig gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis bzod pa gsol mi nus kyi dkris bzhin du 'dug go/ /gzhan ⑩zhig gis smras pa/ de 'di ltar de dang lhan cig gnas pa'i nye gnas yimang po de dag je 0lhung bzed dang chos gos dang / dra ba dang / phor bu dang / ska rags dag gis bsdus la phyis cigar rigs 0par bya'o/ /gzhan zhig gis bzang 8sto de bzhin du bya'o zhes smras nas/ de rnams kyis de dag la kha cig la ni snam 0sbyar byin/kha cig la ni bla gos byin/ kha cig la ni mthang gos byin/ kha cig la ni rngul zan byin/ kha cig la ni gding ba byin/ kha cig la ni lhung bzed 0byin/kha cig la ni chu tshags 8byin te/ de bzhin du de dag thams cad bsdus nas de dag bar na gnas par gyur yito/ /ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa grags pa rim gyis 0phyogs btsal nas yangs pa can du 'ongs pa dang / de dang lhan cig 11—797

gnas pa'i nye gnas dag 'ongs nas yangs pa can dag gi grong ①du ma song bar der lam gyi ②ngal bso ②ba dang / lhan cig gnas pa'i nye gnas dag gis smras pa/ mkhan po phyogs de dag btsal tam/ bu phyogs de dag ring por mi thogs par 'ong ngo / /mkhan po 'tshal to/ /thugs de lta bu kun bzlog ④pa'i rigs te/ ston pa 'das pa de'i gsung rab la rnam pa de dang de dag gis 'tsho bar rung na/ ci'i slad du de dag ⑤la gnod pa bgyi/ des ⑥bsams pa/'di dag sngon ma byung ba'i tshig ci smra ste༅/ nges par 'di dag gis de dag las rang gir ④bya ba blangs par rig nas/ 0tshe dang ldan pa dag sngon ma byung ba'i tshig smra 0ste/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gis de dag las yibadag 8gir bya ba blangs so zhes smras pa dang / de dag cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pas ji ltar gros byas pa de dag la smras pa/ bslab pa lhod pa'i phyogs dag 'phel bas rings par 'ong bar 8rigs pas bstan 8pa'i dgos pa la bshol bar ma byed cig ces tshigs su bcad pa ༅smras pa/ gang gis skreshol bar bya ba rings byed rigs pa shol hubyed pa/ /tshul bzhin bya ba rab spangs byis pa de ni sdug bsngal 0'gro/ /de ni grags ⑫ pa med pa'i skal ldan grogs kyis rnam par spangs/ /de yi don ni mi 'phel mar gyi ༅ngo yi zla ba bzhin/ /gang gis dgongs ⑥pa de bzhin rigs 0byed blo ldan mi shol ba/ /tshul bzhin ma yin pa ③spangs mkhas pa de ni bde ba 'thob 3/ /de ni grags pa skal ldan grogs po rnams kyis ④spangs mi 'gyur/ /de yi don ni 'phel ba yar gyi ngo yi zla ba bzhin/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa tsogags pa 'khor gyi khyams 0su zhugs te rab ⑦kyi mthar phyin pa'i bsam gtan bzhi la snyoms par zhugs nas smon nas 11—798

shes pa brtags ①te/ gaṇ+ḍi de ②brdungs pa dang / dgra bcom pa bdun brgyar gcig gis ma tshang ba de dag thams cad kyang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang lhan cig gnas pa dag ②'dus so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa zla skur 'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gaṇ+ḍi'i ④sgra ma thos so/ /de'i tshe dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams 'dus shing 'tshogs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa grags pas de dag ni ⑥ming nas phyung nyuste brjod na ni 'khrug ②pa chen por 'gyur bas ma la bdag gis ming nas mi 'byung ⑨bar brjod par bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ ⑩des ji ltar rgan rims su 'dud pa byas nas rgan pa'i mtha' logs su thal mo sbyar ba byas nas stan la 'dug ༅go/ /dgra bcom pa bdun brgyar gcig gis ma tshang bas don du gnyer bar 'dod pa dang / de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa zla sgur yang 'gog pa'i snyoms par zhugs ④pa las langs te/ de la lha zhig gis 'phags nyu)pa zla skur ci'i phyir thugs las chung ngus sku bzhugs/khyod dang mkhan po gcig pa dgra bcom pa bdun brgyar gcig gis com tshang ba ni yangs pa can na ④bstan pa gnas par bya ba'i phyir yang dag par sdud par byed pas rings ༅par bzhud cig ces smras pa myedang / des rdzu 'phrul gyis grong khyer dmar bu can nas ⑩mi snang bar gyur te/ yangs pa can du phyin nas 'khor gyi 0khyams kyi sgor 'dug ste sgo la brdungs ⑥pa dang / dge slong dag gis khyod su yin zhes dris so/ /des khutshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang dag dmar bu can na gnas pa yi/ /dge slong tsomang du thos ④pa 'dul ba 'dzin/ /de dag las ni gzhan zhig 'dir 'ongs tebla/ /dbang po dul zhes bya ba sgo na 'dug /dge slong dag gis smras pa/ dbang po dul ba ni gzhan dag kyang 11—799

yod na khyod su yin smros shig /des yang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang dag dmar bu can na gnas pa yi/ /dge sbyong mang du thos pa 'dul ba 'dzin/ /de dag las ni gzhan zhig 'dir 'ongs te/ /the tshom ①bcad ces bya ba sgo na 'dug /dge slong dag gis the tshom ②bcad pa ni gzhan dag kyang yod do zhes smras pa dang / des yang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang dag dmar bu can na gnas pa yi/ /dge sbyong mang du thos pa 'dul ba 'dzin/ /de dag las ni gzhan zhig 'dir 'ongs te/ /'gyod pa med ces bya ba sgo ②na 'dug /dge slong dag gi bya'agyod pa med pa ni gzhan dag kyang yod na su yin zhes smras pa dang /des yang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang dag dmar bu can na gnas pa yi/ /dge sbyong mang du thos pa 'dul ba 'dzin/ /de dag las ni gzhan zhig 'dir 'ongs te/ /zla sgur zhes bya ba ni ④sgo na 'dug /dge slong rnams kyis legs par 'ongs sam legs par 'ongs thosam/ nang du zhugs shig ces smras pa dang /de nang du zhugs so/ /de nas dge slong rnams 'khor gyi cukhyams nas byung nas tshe dang ldan pa zla sgur don du gnyer bar bskor dute/ de'i 'og tu 'khor gyi khyams su zhugs nas 'di ltar rang rang gi stan la 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa grags pas de bzhin rgan rims su 'dug pa la dngos po bcu bzlas par zhugs te / tshe dang ldan pa dag a la la zhes rung bar byed pa rung ngam/ tshe dang ldan pa a la la zhes rung ba zhes bya ba ci yin/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di ltar dge slong kha cig 0mi mthun pas chos ma yin pa dang / mthun pas chos ma yin pa dang / mi mthun ⑩pas chos kyi las byas te a la la zhes rung bar bgyid do/ /tshe dang ldan pa rung ba ma yin no/ /gang du bcas/ tsam par ro/ /gang 11—800

las brten/ dge slong drug sde dag las so/ /ltung ba cir 'gyur/ nyes byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di ni gzhi dang po mdo sde las 'das/'dul ba las 'das/ ston pa'i bstan pa dang bral te/ mdo sde la mi 'jug /'dul ba la mi snang / chos nyid dang 'gal te/ de dag la yangs pa can gyi ①dge slong 'di rnams kyis rung ba ma yin pa rung ngo zhes yongs su bsgrags nas kun du spyod rab tu spyod de/ de dag bdag cag gis dor bar bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag de ni der ②bas te lagazhan dag zhu bar bgyi'o/ /rjes su yi rang bas ༅rung bar bgyid pa rung ngam/ tshe dang ldan pa rjes su yi rang bas ⑤ rung bar byed pa ci yin zhes bya ba'i ༅bar snga ma bzhin du ༅gzhi bcu po rgyas par brjod do/ /de dag gis yang dag par brjod nas 'khor gyi nikhyams nas byung ste / yang gaṇ+ḍi brdungs yonas yangs pa 6can na gnas pa'i dge slong dag dris pa'i tshig gis bsdus nas de dag dang lhan cig tu 'dug pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa grags pas de ltar rgan rims su 'dug pa la gzhi bcu po ming nas phyung ste bzlas pa bya bar 7zhugs te/ tshe dang ldan pa dag a la la zhes bya ba 8rung bar 8byed pa rung ngam/ tshe dang ldan pa a la la zhes rung bar byed pa zhes bya ba ci ④yin/ tshe dang ldan pa dag yangs pa can gyi dge slong 8rnams kyis mi mthun pas chos ma yin pa dang / mthun pas chos ma yin pa dang / mi mthun pas chos kyi las byas te/ a la la zhes bya ba rung bar skyabagyid do/ /tshe dang ldan pa rung ba ma yin no/ /gang du bcas/ 0tsam par ro/ /gang rilas brten/ dge slong drug sde 'dag las so/ /ltung ba cir 'gyur/ nyes byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag yi'adi ni gzhi dang po mdo sde las 'das/ 'dul 11—801

ba ①las 'das/ ston pa'i bstan ②pa dang bral te/ mdo sde la mi 'jug /'dul ba la mi snang / chos nyid dang 'gal te/ de dag la yangs pa can gyi ③dge slong ④rnams kyis rung ba ma yin pa rung ngo zhes yongs su bsgrags ⑤nas kun du spyod pa ༅rab tu spyod de/ de dag bdag cag gis dor bar bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag de ni der bas te 'di zhu ⑦bar bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag ④rjes su yi rang bas rung bar byed pa rung ngam/ tshe dang ldan pa rjes su yi rtsarang bas rung bar byed pa zhes bya ba byaci yin zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin ⑩du gzhi 8bcu po rgyas par brjod dom/ /de dag bdag cag gis dor bar bya'o zhes dgra bcom pa skyobadun brgyas yang dag par brjod pas bdun brgyas yang dag par brjod pa/ bdun brgyas yang dag par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i ming du gyur to// //bar tsasdom ni/ a la la dang rjes su yi rang spyod pa dang / /brtags pa dang ni lan tshwa ri midag dang lam dang nyuX ni/ /sor mo gnyis kyis rung dang dkrugs dang gding ba dang / /gser dngul byas pa 'di ni bar sdom yang dag bsdus / /grong khyer yangs pa can dang nor can dang / /lha las babs dang de bzhin dmar bu can/ /srug na dang ni ma te ldan pa dang / /lhan cig skyes gyur pa ni phyi ma yin/ /thams cad 'dod dang grags dang g.yo ldan dang / /nor can dang ni yid dga' tsodag dang yang / /zla sgur dang ni de bzhin ma pham pa/ /yang dag byung yidang nam gru la sogs ⑩pa'o/ / 'dir 'grel pa las sgo brgyad pa'o zhes sgo brgyad car tshang bar byas so/ / 0'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi rdzogs so// //11—802

rgya gar gyi ①mkhan po bit+yā ②ka ra prabha dang / dharma shrī 0prabha dang /lots+tsha ba ban de ④dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur// // sgo'adul ba lung phran tshegs kyi gzhi 'di sgyur ba'i dus su lots+tsha ba mang pos dum bu mang por bgos te so sor tha dad du bsgyur bas glegs bam du sdom pa'i dus su gnas tha dad du 'thor ⑤nas ma tshang bzhin du bsdebs pas ⑥/ lung phran tshegs phal che ba ma tshang bar bzhugs pa la/ slad kyis la ⑦stod 'ol rgod kyi gtsug lag khang du gnas brtan dar ma seng ges lung sde bzhi bzhengs pa'i tshe dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dul ba 'dzin pa zhing mo che ba byang chub seng ges phyag len mdzad nas spyir dbus gtsang gi gtsug lag khang rnams na bzhugs pa dang /khyad par du bsam yas dumachims phu rtsanas dgas chung ba dang / dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis rnyed pa'i lung rnams dpe yon rtsadang 'bad rtsol chen pos 'tshal ༅te/ de dag la gtugs pas/ lung phran tshegs kha cig la mi bzhugs pa / kha cig la bzhugs pa rnams kyis bskangs nas bsabs pa ni bam po sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i dbu sman 0chen po'i gtam rgyud kyi skabs nas/ sman chen pos smras pa/ gal te 8de lta na skyugs shig dang / bden nam brdzun blta'o zhes smras pa dang zhes bya ba nas bam po sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'i chedabu/ ji tsam na de grong ༅khyer nas byung ba dang / bram ze mong rtul zhes bya bas gos kyi tsomatha' ma nas 'jus nas zhes bya ba'i bar du bam po gcig chad pa bskangs// //sdom ni/ nga yang sman gyis de bzhin no zhes bya ba'i 'og tu yig tshar gcig chad pa bskangs/ de nas bam po sum bcu rtsa bzhi pa'i smad ne tso 0spyod gsal gyi skabs rdzogs pa'i/ e ma'o 'di ltar khyod mkhas pa sha stag dang phrad 11—803

pa ni bsod nams dang ldan no zhes smras so/ /zhes bya ba nas bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'i stod// //spyi'i sdom ni/ dge slong ma'i bkur sti ②bri zhes bya ba'i bar du bam po sum bcu rtsa bzhi pa'i smad nas bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'i stod kyi ②bar bam po dgu chad pa bskangs/ sdom tshig de'i 'og tu sdom tshig yig tshar gcig chad pa bskangs / de nas bam po bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa'i mjugaci /bram ze'i khye'u ma sdug gi gleng gzhi'i bskabs kyi/ dge sbyong rnams kyi yon po'i spyad kyi log pa'i 'tsho ⑤ba de lta bu las slar log pa yin no zhes bya ba nas/ bam po bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'i dbu/ de nas de'i tshe/ bram ze pad ma'i snying po khyim mchog gi sa mthon po zhig na shas che ba'i bram ze rgan rabs rnams dang lhan cig 'dus shing 'khod ⑥par gyur to zhes bya ༅ba'i bar du bam po bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa chad pa bskangs so/ /de nas bam po lnga bcu pa'i mjug /kun dga' bo la gdams pa'i skabs kyi/ kun dga' bo dge slong 'di lta bu ni bdag nyid gling dang /bdag nyid skyabs dang / chos kyi gling dang / chos kyi skyabs kyis gnas par bya'idu / gling gzhan dang / skyabs gzhan gyis ni ma yin no zhes bya ba nas bam po lnga bcu gnyis pa'i stod⑨// //bar sdom ni/ tsa ⑩pa la dang che'i 'du byed mdzad ces bya ba'i bar du bam po gcig chad pa bskangs te/ spyir bsdoms na bam po bcu gnyis dang /sdom tshig yig tshar gnyis chad pa bskangs pa gang yin pa de nyid gangs can gyi ⑪rgyud kyi gnas brtan chen po sdom brtson mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur cing / 'dul ba dang / mdo sde dang / sde snod kyi ma mo 'dzin pa 11wa 804

shākya'i dge slong shes bya'i nam mkha' la mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas shing /snyan grags kyi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur pa mchims thams cad mkhyen pas/ la stod 'ol rgod kyi gtsug lag khang nas dpe phyi gdan drangs nas bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du lung sde bzhi tshang la dag par bzhengs shing / de nyid la dpe phyi byas shing / khyad par du'ang ma tshang ba kha bskangs pa'i phran tshegs de nyid la dpe phyi byas nas/shākya'i dge sbyong ①'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur dpe phyi la gdan drangs nas/ dpal ldan rgyal ba'i sde yis/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs dus kun du dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ thub pa chen po'i bka'/lung gzhi dang / dge slong pha ma'i rnam 'byed rnam pa gnyis dang / gzhung bla ma rnams kyi ma tshang ba kha bskong bar byed pa'i lung phran tshegs 'di dag cing tshang bar dpal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhengs so/ /slad nas lung (sdo dīsna rno / sbya dī k+to ༵ ༵nga bam po'i ༵༵sa dbu nas rim pa bzhin du grangs sne—11—805
